notes.title: Airmen 1.17.2: Ship Legs
notes.content:
The second implementation of the walker legs is now available and equipable on your ship. Walker legs are the first ground-based movement part added to the game. While their relevance on the archipelago will be nonexistent they should at least be a fun addition to watercraft. The walker legs can propel your ship forward and backward, turn the ship, crouch and stand, and even strafe if their assigned weapon group is activated. Just like their miniature counterparts they can stick to surfaces of any steepness. Unlike the small walkers these legs are not able to stand on other ships or jump. Walker legs are unlock by researching "Pressure Actuation".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/72ed633e2c239d2cc5b956bc367ace29e9703ed5.png

Two new walker dragoon variants are also available including a vertically mounted guided rocket walker and a requested cargo carrying walker. The rocket walker is unlock by researching "Pressure Actuation" and completing the quest "A Mysterious Weapon". The carrier walker is unlocked by researching "Pressure Actuation".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/a4473ff0c329578f3188cb912238928bd170242f.png

Future development of Airmen will begin replacing the existing Archipelago with an entirely new map. The size of this project will likely break the weekly update schedule. Each week, in place of the regular content update, the new map will be updated and playable on an independent server. Once the new map comes close to parity with the old one, the old map will be retired. The goal of the new map is to expand Airmen's potential content by creating an environment that can support a wide variety of vehicles beyond airships and boats.

1.17.2
Major Features

Minor Features
Added Walker Dragoon Rocket.

notes.title: Airmen 1.17.1: Walker Dragoons
notes.content:
Walker Dragoons climb into the archipelago this week introducing an all new format of deployable vehicle. Walkers, unlike other dragoons, cannot fly, but instead can crawl up and down and underneath the steep surfaces of the archipelago. The walkers arrive with two variants: a plain scout-like setup and a battle setup equipped with a flak cannon. You can unlock the vanilla walker dragoon by researching "Pressure Actuation" and the flak walker by additionally researching "Flak Weaponry".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/5b03607fbb07096335e3221ab862ff1971bf032e.png

Piloting the walkers without flipping them over and blocking your only exit hatch will take some practice so be sure to enable tooltips for you first attempt and learn the controls. Knowing when to switch between automatic orientation and aiming orientation can help a lot with navigating difficult terrain. Over the next few updates expect new variants of the walker dragoons and new implementation of the spider leg tech.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/f575dd9361136fb4a743c694e4dec9008400d847.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.17.1
Major Features
Added Walker Dragoons.
Minor Features
Boarding charges deal 10 damage when planted.
Added a beam mounted bone cannon.
Bug Fixes
Fixed beta ships ignoring changes to their weapon groups.
Fixed the sub parts menu not going away when the parts list is closed.

notes.title: Airmen 1.17.0: Ship Joints
notes.content:
Ship joints are now available allowing for rigid connections between ships. Ship joints can be placed anywhere on your ship and will automatically link to another nearby joint on another ship. Once joined the ships are linked together at one point but up to three total connections can be made between two ships to form a completely rigid connection perfect for a monstrous combined ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/a96c1baccb130968cbd6799ad73c3064a69eb48d.png

The two types of joints, alpha and beta, can be used to propagate steering input across connected ships. When an alpha joint connects to a beta joint, all normal steering input on the ship with the beta joint is ignored and the steering input of the ship with the alpha joint is used instead. Alpha/beta connections are ideal for rigid combination ships and beta/beta or alpha/alpha connections are ideal for non-rigid combination ships like trains or other towing configurations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/00dda8c45c5b3980c0f4a417d512fd1862702658.png

Ship joints will snap if under enough force or if a joint ejector is activated. When building combined ships, be sure to spread out the joints for the most stable connection. If the joints are giving you trouble and you suspect a bug to be at play, please be sure to post the ship and a screenshot of the ship along with your report. Remember that joints are simple physics interactions and cannot benefit from the many simplifications applied to ships such as propeller torque reduction and center of lift adjustment. A ship in two parts will behave different than the same ship in one part.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.17.0
Major Features
Added ship joints.
Minor Features
Added beam mounted variants of the flak cannon, lance cannon, and quad cannon.
Bug Fixes

notes.title: Airmen 1.16.4: Water and Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Late last week the water overhaul arrived unannounced changing the tiled bumps of the ocean into more random and subtle swells and waves. The feature was experimental and came with a big performance hit. This week's update further optimizes that system and more to finalize the new waves and negate their original performance impact. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/e47503a7805acfbc9cb7cdd7b60462f267c5b1b6.png

Notably this update removes the game's launcher, shifting keybinding options, resolution, and window/fullscreen into the settings menu. The new in-game configurable keybindings are built on an entirely new input system so you may notice small changes to your mouse sensitivity and need to rebind any custom controls you set up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/518ad2f27c7f547d516e7c548a1cc70e00dd1512.png

This week's update includes an update to the game engine which may introduce weird new bugs from nowhere. If you notice anything please let me know by posting in the official Discord's #bug_reports channel or leaving a comment here.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Generally improved performance due to engine update.
Minor Features

Improved the smoothness of depth calculations.

notes.title: Airmen 1.16.3: Autohammer Coverage Overlay
notes.content:
Airmen 1.16.3 introduces a new quality of life feature in the hangar: the autohammer coverage overlay. Selecting an autohammer for placement will highlight all parts with coverage. This new quality of life feature should save meticulous builders some time and help explain what a repair range of 4 really means.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/a88d1a9db80801a0f8f1b84f85189a3ca757bf0d.png

Improved the crosshair notes that appear when interacting with cargo pads.

notes.title: Airmen 1.16.2: Bounty Hunter Coins
notes.content:
The reworked skull bounty system continues expansion this update adding a reward for bountiless victims who fend off aggressive pirates. Destroying a skull bounty ship while lacking one yourself now grants every member of the crew a special new resource called bounty coins. Bounty coins can be exchanged at Tower Reckongale for one of 4 basic resources or Smuggler's Den for one of 4 rare resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/b3d729669212266cf78f3d50838e9c859fe2777b.png

Bounty coins are rewarded based on the size of the bounty. Every 5 gold of bounty over 15 provides an additional coin on top of a base 1 coin. Ships that fly the black flag however are worth no bounty coins until surpassing 25 bounty at which point the reward scales at a rate of 1 coin per 5 bounty.

notes.title: Airmen 1.16.1: Adjustable Guided and Unguided Rocket Pods
notes.content:
The battery cannon adjustable weapon platform gets its first addition with the guided and unguided rocket pods. These new weapons bring the feel of barrage cannons to the adjustable weapon category with the small scale of the battery. Both weapons match the firepower of the heavy battery cannons.

The unguided rocket pods hit harder than a battery but their low speed and poor accuracy means they'll be most effective at short ranges against heavy ships. The guided rocket pods are far weaker than battery cannons but can be aimed midair. 

The guided rocket pods should be much more versatile than their unguided counterpart at the cost of damage when used most effectively. Both weapons are unlocked along with their turreted counterparts as part of Barrage Weaponry Research and the seeker cannon quest "A Mysterious Weapon".

notes.title: Airmen 1.16.0: Skull Bounty Rework
notes.content:
Everyone's least favorite opt-in pvp mechanic, skull bounties, get an overhaul this update. Skull bounties are now integrated into the normal bounty system and are automatically acquired at a bounty of 15 gold. Ships with skull bounties are marked on the map for all players. As previously, ships with skull bounties can destroy each other for a resource reward based on the build cost of the victim. The new twist comes with the addition of the pirate king. The player with the highest skull bounty becomes the pirate king if there is not already a pirate king. The pirate king gets double rewards for claiming skull bounties but their skull bounty can be claimed by any other crew (even if they lack a skull bounty themselves) and is doubled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29199374/cfdbce2e2aed13df821cb8ffd70e811a0197d87b.png

The new skull bounty system aims to improve on the original by removing the hard opt-in mechanic without rewarding pirates for picking on players that don't want to fight. The pirate king mechanic gives a reason for bountyless players to get involved in the fighting and keeps pirates most interested in fighting other pirates. Returning skull bounties to their always visible state combined with the automatic skull bounty at 15 bounty should help pacifist player avoid the most dangerous players on a server.

notes.content:

You'll notice lots of splotchy dirt peeking through the grass and irregularly trimmed cliff faces as opposed to the geometrically consistent details of the past. The terrain changes are a big step up in level of detail but I expect it to fit considering the massive size of terrain compared to the textureless airmen and airships.

notes.title: Airmen 1.15.5: Save Browser Overhaul
notes.content:
The save browser gets a new look and upgraded functionality in this weekly update. notes.title: Airmen 1.14.11: Anti-Personnel Auto Turret
notes.content:
This week's update introduces the anti-personnel auto turret, a new weapon intended to shift the burden of execution closer to the attackers when it comes to successful boarding. The APAT is an extremely short range (10 meter) auto turret with unrestricted rotation that can only target and damage airmen. The turret does no damage to parts but will kill an airman in about one second. All turrets will remain loyal to the original owner of the ship regardless of who controls it but they can still be stopped with a hold fire command. Boarders are no match for these turrets and will have to move carefully and attack creatively to circumvent them or do their work on unprotected parts of the ship. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8cc6d211a8a1074ed06a8d409e54ee5a4e82d6e3.png

The APAT will undoubtedly diminish the effectiveness of boarding only strategies especially on small ships where complete coverage is easy. Large ships will have to be smarter when taking advantage of the APAT focusing on defending critical locations to avoid cutting into their firepower budget as the part itself comes with a 300 firepower cost. Well coordinated crews should be entirely capable of defusing the weak turrets ahead of boarding using precision weapons. Boarding should remain relevant overall and but the highest priority targets will be off limits until some traditional ship-to-ship combat has taken place. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/2f4ad5760b09009df6da37758387aff2bea172e4.png

Some other boarding related tweaks have also been added this update. Bonus health on respawn has been increase from 150 to 200 which means you will no longer need to be better than a boarder to win fists vs sword after respawning and should win sword vs sword with 100 hit points to spare. The original owners of a ship will now be able to open its hatches even if control of the ship is lost so they can now be placed without need for a steering wheel on either side. 

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.11

Major Features

Minor Features
Hatches can always be opened by the team that spawned a ship even if they don't control it.

Added rocks to copse and tooth.

Added a settings menu accessible from expedition and sandbox.

Taking the wheel of a player fort does not change its team.

Updated the starter ship with an anti-personnel turret.

Increased bonus hp on respawn from 150 to 200.

Fixed invisible trees on tooth.

AI turrets will not longer track player targets after they are not longer targetable.

Fixed AI turrets not holding their shot when an ally airman would immediately block the shot.

notes.title: Airmen 1.14.10: Synthesizers and Armor Plates
notes.content:
The synthesizers are an all new expedition activity designed to get battles started in the corners of the archipelago. A single synthesizer on the archipelago will activate at a time and after a 15 minute countdown the nearest ship within 100 meters of the deadly fan blades will receive a random resource reward on top of a small amount of a new resource: synthest. For more info about the synthesizers check the in-expedition objective menu or the new quest "Synthesizer Steel".

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/dc23dd42cfba5c0035c80cf298bf152193995d69.png

Armor plating is a new category of parts available after completing the quest "Synthesizer Steel". They provide a quick and painless way of adding a second layer of armor to the most commonly targeted locations of your ship. Armor plates keep a similar hp/surface area ratio as hull but sport a slightly higher damage reduction and 50% reduced mass/surface area ratio. Armor plates should serve as a minor durability reward for ships built with spare mass or already utilizing double layered hull plates. Armor plates require synthest to use so get out onto the archipelago and unlock those synthesizers! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8bd671604db088a1f0dfb987214cab4384304e35.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.10

Major Features

Unlocked the resource synthesizers.

Added armor plating.

Minor Features

Added an objective description for installations.

Added a marker above cargo pads when carrying a parcel with tool tips enabled.

Default controls are now listed in expedition when tooltips are enabled.

Ram sides now automatically use their mirrored variant in mirror placement.

Added a new hammer, axe, and chest cosmetic.

notes.title: Airmen 1.14.9: Adjustable Adjustments
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/885657028ab0a5cee15e619e4a21c7cf4752e7f0.png

Adjustables across the board have received a minor rework this update. Every adjustable in a group is now independent meaning if one member of the group cannot adjust all others still will. While being able to partially align guns is strictly inferior to being able to align all guns, this change should put the nail in the coffin for adjustables getting stuck on each other and allow for ship designs using adjustables in differing orientations. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/acf8c37398e370d35210203d6198c6e1122d9608.png

The delivery changes this update aim to make the contract class more diverse by injecting variety into how they are typically done. Previously, the 32 parcel delivery was the golden boy of deliveries being accessible and easy to do in a sturdy ship. The higher ranking deliveries were only taken on by novelty boats and cargo pad spamming ships optimized for speed. By keeping all new delivery formats in the range of 32-64 parcels haulers can focus less on pad spam and have some slight variety in their options.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b1094885ff645e3a1d2a82dd8b8253ad4acf7a93.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.9

Major Features

Reworked delivery contract "difficulty" to give different flavors of deliveries rather than increasing both parcel count and locations.

An adjustable weapon group is no longer denied movement if one weapon in the group is blocked.

Camera controlling adjustable weapons now aligns weapons in different starting orientations.

Minor Features

Destroying standalone parts (dragoons, missiles, mines) from a ship does not earn the attacker a bounty.

Added rocks to ridgeline.

Overhauled the appearance of the clouds on the horizon.

Added blizzard weather.

Added a contract abandon special action to all contract forts with a 15 minute cooldown. The action starts on cooldown when you join.

Adjusted the missile silo model and hitbox to fit through a 1x1 hole.

An adjustable weapon group can only have up to 3 control stations in it.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the altitude maintainer not being available on forts.

Fixed adjustables being able to get permanently stuck on each other.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.8: Server Browser UI Overhaul
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/81b53e7192de6430167f45f7eac835650d282eec.png

The overhauled server browser arrives this update phasing out one of the older pieces of user interface in the game. The new menus utilize the previously empty space and apply the user interface style of the expedition lobby making all the buttons big and obvious. Some under the hood server browser updates have also been applied that should get servers appearing in the list immediately and prevent listed servers from disappearing when a refresh occurs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/5019bdfcce9c17d3fdc9c6d175bb359f8d589d13.png

The new propeller category, heavy propellers, is now available by researching hardened gearing. These props closely adhere to the shape of the single prop with some small stat tweaks that increase mass and pressure cost for a proportional thrust gain. Both the new heavy propellers and single prop also receive shortened versions allowing ships that don't need the extended prop shaft to reduce their mass. 

1.14.8

Major Features

Overhauled the server browser UI.

Minor Features

Added the heavy propeller and a short variant of it.

Added a short variant of the single propeller.

Added rocks to cauldron and horizon.

Game mode can now be selected in the server creation window.

Refreshing the server list no longer causes any previously detected servers to disappear. 

The server list now updates in the background of the hangar so a complete list is immediately ready when switching to the browser.

Bug Fixes

Fixed dragoons not returning to the docked orientation if docked while tilted.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.7: Terrain Improvements
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b9d879729b3d4de252672be796417fe18588eda1.png

Airmen 1.14.7 begins a process of updating the island visuals. This update improves the cliff face shader and adds large rocks to cliff faces. Since this is the start of a longer process, you will only find these large rocks at Harbor, Lookout, Atoll, and Table for now. The shader improvements also come with a performance cost and will become the new "high" for the "terrain quality" setting. The old style is now "medium" and will be default for all current players. If you want to see the new cliff face shader select "high" for "terrain quality" in the in-game settings menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9eb91201442b76aed5dcd9172527179a588fe262.png

Two small quality of life features are also added this update. Picking up or equipping a parcel now informs you of its contents on your crosshair so you don't have to remember the contents or guess when you take it from a cage. When an engine or filled pressure well is destroyed on a ship, a short engine destruction sound will play to inform your repairmen of their shame. The sound plays from the position of the destroyed part but will not play if another engine is destroy while it is already playing to prevent any audio onslaughts.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.7

Major Features

Began adding large rocks to island cliff faces to make them look more like rocky cliff faces. Harbor, Atoll, Lookout, and Table have been updated. The other Islands will be updated in the near future.

Minor Features

Added a sound when a filled pressure well or engine is destroyed nearby.

Picking up or equipping a parcel informs you of its contents on the crosshair.

Improved the terrain shader with normal mapped cliff faces. Because this new shader costs additional performance, the old style is the new "medium" for "terrain quality". Anyone using the old "high" setting must change their "terrain quality" setting back to "high" in the in-game settings menu.

Added oil to lookout.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the tree trunk texture being blurry and stretched out.

Fixed incorrect part stats for mag beam and mag beam focuser firepower.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.6: Daily Quests
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/bd170fa572f3cdeb709a0f485ce19ce762962d7e.png

Daily quests are now available in Airmen 1.14.6. These new quests refresh every day at midnight and are unique for each player. Currently each daily quest tier pulls from varying difficulties of contract completions, resource extraction, and other miscellaneous activities like sieges and installations. Daily quests will only update when you launch the game so you won't have to rush to complete them during late night sessions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/119eb7c4e8e1b015eff8413b2662d01c4088d750.png

Most research perquisites are removed this update to help reduce the perceived cost of completing research. While individual researches can be completed much faster than anyone could possibly exhaust the uses of the parts unlocked, players that choose to build with locked parts can set their sights on goals out of their reach and gain nothing from the things they unlock along the way. By removing the "tree" element of the research system players can start directly working to the parts they want.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.6

Major Features

Added random daily quests.

Minor Features

Removed most perquisite researches for researches that have them.

Added two brighter rain variants: bright heavy rain and drizzle.

Bug Fixes

Fixed AI gunners not appearing on ships with scorpion dragoons.

Fixed non-siege players who join a siege being removed from it after each wave.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.5: Cargo Mounted Part Variants and Altitude Maintainer
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/770d668144d41fbd0e02e2bd1cd585f265ae6a6d.png

Cargo mounted part variants are now available for all parts with a single beam connection face and the heavy cannon. All parts affected by this change can now be mounted on the flat surfaces of armor rather than a beam or hull root. These variant parts are automatically switched to when your crosshair passes over a surface that would match one of the variants.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c93df2a809529018cee515ebeab948e149b7850e.png

A new research "Automated Control" is now available which includes the previously unlocked-by-default roll corrector and tilt module and a new part, the altitude maintainer. The altitude maintainer is a small part assigned to a weapon group that takes control over vertical thrust to maintain the altitude of the ship when it was enabled. This should be a useful tool for cargo ships that are dragged down when overweight or submarines looking to just barely crest the waves.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b0fe08b3c81a63ef5ccd19e932c6663375bdec3d.png

Many other small changes and fixes are included in this update in response the some of the feedback coming in from new players. Remember, if you have any issues the best place to report them is the official Discord channel.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.5

Major Features

Added cargo mount variants of every part with a single beam connection and the heavy cannon. These variants are automatically switched to when you look at a matching surface.

Minor Features

Ships newly uploaded to the steam workshop now have weight class tags and a tag for free ships.

Added the altitude maintainer.

Added the new research "Automated Control" that unlocks the tilt module, roll corrector, and new altitude maintainer.

Shrunk chat text size and added spacing between each message to improve readability.

Visually improved the building warnings.

Moved the rescue and capture drop off marker to the fort. Rescues can still be dropped off at any tunnel entrance.

Small armored balloons are now unlocked with "armored balloons" research instead of "large armored balloons".

Allied players can now see each other's name tags above their heads.

Improved position sync when players move from one platform to another.

Bug Fixes

Fixed high ping and packet loss causing other players to fly away into oblivion.

Increased flak cannon barrel collision hitbox size to prevent them from getting stuck on each other when turning.

Fixed ships not being able to upload to the steam workshop.

Fixed the armored balloon not appearing until large armored balloons are unlocked.

notes.title: Airmen 1.14.4: 6 New Balloons, Black Knight Dragoon, and Fireworks
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/2e4f8fffedb71900aa255c55334d8758dbd56158.png

Box balloons are now available. These balloons are big, blocky, and loaded with connection points so you can easily lay out the overall shape of your ship. Since these new balloons will likely be the easiest to use of any balloon shape they will be unlocked from the start requiring no additional research.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/e25438b94b2c00e0c18b1afb456d2bdf4f9f5554.png

A new quest is available that takes you on a series of ghost hunts culminating in a battle with the ghost ship summonable on Harbor. Completing this quests unlocks the black knight dragoon, a variant of the armor dragoon that raises directly up and down rather than tilting. If you have already completed all obelisk levels and defeated the ghost ship this quest will be ready to claim.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/6db4cb073c9051a0d3ae6f3f7436b513135c8b57.png

Two years ago today Airmen released on Steam. It has received over 100 content updates since then and this year you can celebrate with 7 colors of anniversary fireworks. You can permanently unlock the fireworks cannons by launching an expedition any time in the next 7 days. The fireworks cannon is not a real weapon and should be used for celebratory purposes only.

notes.title: Airmen 1.14.3: Armor and Scorpion Dragoon
notes.content:

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.2: Transport and Hauler Dragoons
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b019109628442a339bd991e1d6659afe79c13829.png

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.1: Hands Free Dragoon Riding
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/1140ca393a199a3fc08e13b39b359294e10e01d3.jpg

Due to the upcoming holiday, this week's scheduled update is releasing early. 

The final dragoon core functionality, tool usage while riding, it now available. While piloting a dragoon, pressing Left Control locks and releases the controls allowing full usage of any carried tools. Pilots can grapple up parcels, fire their lever actions, or plant boarding charges.

To help alleviate the added power of boarding charges combined with dragoons, charges can now be shot off using any firearm. 

1.14.1

Major Features

You can use Left Control to release the controls of a dragoon and use tools.

Minor Features

Boarding charges can be shot off with firearms.

Your grappling gun is now visible while riding dragoons or using turrets.

Increased dragoon docking zone size.

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.14.0: Dragoons
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/22a359700bb7e7f40cbf77daa96e3e48d526f371.jpg

Dragoons speed across the Archipelago this update. Dragoons are a new deployable vehicle you can mount and pilot independently of your ship. These flying bikes serve as a quick form of airman transportation ideal for short range scouting, ship transfer, or resource retrieval. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/2e3df830697f3ed40fc473b3e7b4b7e900f515ac.jpg

Dragoons have the potential to wildly impact player versus player combat so its important to know their limitations. If a pesky dragoon won't stop buzzing around your ship target deployables can be used to swat them out of the air. Dragoons cannot travel far from their home ship and will self destruct when passing this threshold (the left dial indicates this range). Once a dragoon is destroyed it cannot return but it can be repaired before its destroyed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/92b746d9a45a47493de8822f6122d444b4e24b59.jpg

The first available dragoon class is the scout, a high speed dragoon with no fancy features. More classes will be added in future updates.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.14.0

Major Features

Added dragoons. Dragoons are independent flying vehicles you can mount and pilot.

Minor Features

Tapping E on a cargo pad will store cargo in your hands. Holding E will take cargo.

Random island fort spawns no longer carry high density cargo. High density cargo is now only on ships without a damage nerf such as cargo ships.

Taking cargo from a bountyless ship will earn you a bounty.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the local player colliding with dead players.

Fixed the painted chest not coloring on the first person body.

Fixed turret AI ignoring player targets unless told to target them.

Fixed flowers jittering when the camera moved.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.13.11: Healing Stations and Drone Targeting
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/438041d9c94fa3e840dd2cde978f84c0c2328732.jpg

This update introduces two new major features to help airmen survive the Archipelago. You can now outfit your ship with healing stations placeable like the existing tool boards. After a 3 second activation channel you recover up to 50 hitpoints.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/bad72446ca731f3dbd178f95d48886162a3b8bfd.jpg

Drone targeting has been added to the options for crew orders. Drone targeting will automatically happen when no ship is in range. Similar to other targeting options, when no drones are present engines targeting will be used. The reload command has been moved to the left side of the crew orders menu to make space.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.13.11

Major Features

Added healing stations as a ship part.

You can select "target deployables" in crew orders to set all AI gunners and autoturrets to target drones and mines.

Added a rudder torque limit that scales based on ship mass.

Minor Features

Taking damage while channeling an activatable aborts the channel.

Reinforcement spawns use the same buff/nerf levels as the ship that spawned them.

Damage buffs/nerfs now apply to fixed cannons and drones.

AI turrets will immediately look for a new target if their current target is destroyed.

Increased gatling gun armor penetration by 5.

You can mount over top AI gunner turrets to take control of them. The Aerial Combat Commission highly recommends not using this feature during combat.

Fixed grappling gun pulling too hard when hitting parcels.

Fixed parts connecting at multiple points registering each other as connected multiple times.

Fixed sieges spawning on islands with installations.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.13.10: Siege UI and 6 New Cosmetics
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f6bd6f843a2c7fe8ec0978d35848709cbf5c66db.png

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.13.9: Capture Contracts and Siege Ships
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/fa3883632bc3c0011ad6b30d4ddf4e712d983650.png

Capture contracts are now available in the new high elevation basement of Tower Reckongale. Similar to rescue contracts, capture contracts require returning a ship to a fort but with all the added complications of that ship being fully functional and highly hostile. Rewards for completing these contracts are much higher compared to rescues.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/cc1d142fff40b7a4ef4a3b07782fe879f7505318.png

Expedition sieges also receive a rework now allowing the optional use of any custom ship alongside the siege fort. You can bring this ship at no resource cost but are restricted from leaving the island. Some sieges are not available to watercraft due to the lack of nearby water.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/399dd8566a3a161dd88e108d54401200dde21f0f.png

Grappling guns have also been reworked. Rather than their flexible instantaneous pull they will now pull consistently over a short period of time. This makes them stupidly easy to use and if the cooldown didn't exists you could precisely navigate ships without touching WASD. If you never learned how to jump before the pull you'll now be relentlessly scraped over every obstacle in your way.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.13.9

Major Features

Added Capture contracts available at Tower Reckongale.

You can now select a ship when playing sieges for no resource cost. If a siege player leaves the island they will be returned to hangar. If a siege ship leaves the island it will be immediately destroyed.

Minor Features

Decreased flak cannon AoE priming range from 100m to 80m.

Added more loading progress text.

Reworked grappling gun to pull over a short period of time rather than apply a single force.

Improved the rope shader to actually look like rope. Applied to the grappling gun and harpoon.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the grappling gun projectile's shaky movement when fired from a moving platform.

Fixed the grappling gun not inheriting platform velocity when fired from a moving platform.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.13.8: Rescue Contracts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f91c397d3a5df57b330d3d668ce4df2cac031f10.jpg

Rescue contracts are now available at select forts on the Archipelago. Travel to Castle Orenvaald or the Tsuchev Ruins with your harpoon equipped ship to take on these new contracts. Rescue contracts require you to travel to a nearby island, locate the rescue ship, and escort it back to the fort that provided the contract.

Rewards are based on the rescue's distance from the fort and contract rank. On top of the normal resource rewards you can unlock two new cosmetics for completing rescues of any rank and rescues of B rank or higher.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/09e3712bd8a81333a28d3629a0c1800397bb4af8.png

notes.title: Airmen 1.13.6: Conquest Mode
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b0ffa425be43d461f518acedac6ef957af8b60a2.jpg

This week's update adds a new game mode: Conquest. Conquest attempts to bring PvP focused gameplay that doesn't fall flat when there aren't enough people to fill a server, a major problem with the older Escort Mode. Conquest is a capture-the-point style persistent battle across the whole Archipelago. The first team to lose all their capture points loses. Some islands are reinforced with AI for defense and offense that prevent the mode from feeling completely empty. Conquest has nothing to do with resources so you can bring any ship without cost or the required research unlike in Expedition Mode.

You'll be able to play Conquest on the official EU server but remember this is an early version of the game mode and some much needed features are obviously incomplete or missing. If you encounter any game breaking bugs while playing don't forget to report them and post your log files in the Discord.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.13.4: Smuggling Contracts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/139186e4dd1c0d00e6905d9e7cffce51e763ae92.jpg

Smuggling contracts are a new activity to chip away at your mountain of gold in exchange for resources. Like original deliveries, these contracts are bought with gold. In exchange, you'll be given an island location and a bounty for your illegal activities. One of the tunnel entrances on the island will contain the promised resources. Once you get nearby a benevolent bounty hunter will come seeking justice so either be fast or be combat ready.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/bfde48932a47b9f0102325c4454c90320f2dfc85.jpg

Along with your gold, this update also chips away at the power of autohammers. After keeping them around for a while, its clear their function is providing a temporary invulnerability rather than a way to recover from damage. Almost all weapons other than reasonably sized blast cannon arrays could not cut through their repair rate so the repair speed of autohammers has been cut in half. This change has no effects on the amount of repairs a hammer can do before needing crew attention or the efficiency of their scrap use.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

notes.title: Airmen 1.13.3: Ram and Rail Gun Rework, Part List Groups
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/4fe099d79a9eb719d7c7e8f435b3fef3110ad394.jpg

This week overhauls two underutilized weapons. The lighter of the two, Rail Guns, have been overhauled and renamed to Magnetic Beams. Mag Beam ships utilize focusers the same way Rail Guns did but the weapon now fires a continuous 3 second beam dealing damage 10 times to parts caught in the beam.

The new damage profile circumvents the Rail Gun's difficulty of reliably hitting single shots by giving pilots a window to line up the shot and get partial damage. The sustained beam also allows the weapon to deal more damage overall since landing all shots on the same parts will only be possible on a stationary target.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/940c99439beb70ccb903ae9c2f24ac83f3b315b7.jpg

Rams also receive a rework this update. Rams posed many balance issues by being situationally easy to use and inconsistent in their damage application. New rams prevent a single ram from hitting the same part twice in one ram or hitting it again without actually colliding again. 

On top of functionality improvements, their limiting systems have also been improved. Instead of setting the ship on a global no-ram-cooldown after one hit, every ship has a ram damage limit that maximizes at 25% ship mass and decays from 100% to 0% in 10 seconds. This means that heavy ships, those hardest to pull off rams with, deal the hardest hits but light ships, those easiest to pull off rams with, will not be destroying functional parts in one touch.

The new system means hitting with more rams deals more damage so a new style of ram, the blade ram, has been added to utilize this feature. Blade rams do the most damage when dragged along colliding parts compared to the original rams that excel at impacting targets. They also make your ship look really cool.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c2756dad15990c56d165bb1e3e732d9d95fbc4f1.jpg

Finally, the parts menu sees some improvements with part groups. Similar parts are now put into expanding groups to prevent clutter in the list. You can see the number of parts in a group in the upper right hand corner of the image and just a single click is sufficient to select the top level part of the group. You can disable this feature in the settings if you've sufficiently acclimated to the previous list.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.13.3

Major Features

Reworked and rebalanced rams. Hitting with more rams now deals more damage but ships have a "ram damage cap" equal to 1/4 their mass. The limited value constantly lowers and takes 10 seconds to reset from full. Any one ram cannot ram the same part again until 10 seconds of no ramming have passed.

Added blade rams. Blade rams deal the most damage when dragged across a surface.

Minor Features

Spectating while on a pilot seat in sandbox (default key "V") changes to an orbiting camera setup that tracks the ship.

Reworked and renamed the rail gun to the magnetic beam cannon. It now fires a sustained beam dealing damage to everything inside 10 times during the beam.

AI part targeting now ranks parts based on percent HP instead of raw HP. This reduces the effectiveness of "bait" components.

Rail gun audio is now audible down the length of the beam.

Parts with A and B variants will now only show one option in the parts list and automatically select the option that will connect when mousing over a surface.

Improved the lance cannon hit particle.

Reduced audio cutouts in big fights by making AI controlled turrets fire as part of a ship wide audio system. Audio from quick bursts will be grouped into one playback.

Bug Fixes

Fixed crashes occurring randomly in the server browser.

Fixed random circular explosions from flaks and siege cannons.

Fixed part icons disappearing until resorted when the main menu was opened.

Fixed a bug where setting crew shares to 0 would cause the captain to lose resources from contracts.

Fixed harvest contract collecting values at higher levels.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.17: Flak Cannon and Updated Explosions
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/113c12249ea1f4dc5e32b1ff79055e1ecf1a6a36.png

Flak cannons introduce a new category of airship weaponry. Flak cannons work similarly to adjustable cannons but can only be accessed remotely from control stations. notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.15: Footsteps and a First Person Body
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8482362d386689b9e29ace7eba3f4a526b024f59.jpg

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.13: New Island, New Weapon
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/83a923210566a8d7d4928f1d5827fb25815cd8bf.png

This week's update may be feature light but has laid the framework for some massive terrain improvements. Burrow, the new island appearing on the archipelago this update, has been created with a new custom terrain tool. This tool greatly decreases the time it takes to make good terrain and allows for more novel terrain designs. All future islands will be created with this tool so the extreme features that make piloting airships fun can be used to their fullest.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.12: Barrage Cannon and Adjustable Gatlings

notes.title: Airmen 1.12.11: Robot Sky Whales
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c2d977fe4bcbd7167a9923dca6c03f4922ddb21a.jpg

Airmen 1.12.11 expands on the archipelago's synthetic wild life with robot sky whales. These creatures appear all across the archipelago and most frequently in its northeastern reaches. Once the majesty on these great creatures wears off, you can viciously poach them by targeting their weak points breaking off parcels of hardened aetherium and resonant magnesite. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/6531136176dd93f8cff0249e27d5c946f237d9cb.jpg

No whales were harmed in the making of this update.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.11

Major Features

Added robot sky whales. Damaging their vital components drop parcels of hardened aetherium and resonant magnesite. Whales spawn most frequently in the northeast.

Minor Features

Added extra scaling to installations increasing the HP of every ship in the installation.

Improved the AIs long distance travel piloting abilities.

Changed the first person lever action grip animation.

Bug Fixes

Fixed harvests using reverse difficulty for determining the required amount of delivered parcels.

Fixed reactivating the teleporter launch button resetting the charge.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.10: Tilt Controls
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9cd235998856497dc56c6e061aa016500c4c4044.jpg

Airmen 1.12.10 introduces a new form of vertical propulsion, tilt controls. The tilt module can be placed anywhere on your ship and toggled using a weapon group. While activated, rear vertical propulsion inverts allowing a strong torque to be applied by a evenly distributed vertical propulsion setup. This change can massive increase the maneuverability of an airship so I'll be watching the power levels are parts that synergize well with it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/0cd2052772acc696a9d91c6b23a51aeab0738c6e.jpg

Autohammers are also receiving a serious change to help eliminate the necessity of autohammer spam. While autohammers are essential to a top of the line ship, the extent of their use has gone too far. All autohammers now consume 200 pressure while their weapon group is active and for 1.25 seconds after their weapon group is disabled. This new cost does not stack with their normal 800 pressure cost 10 seconds after performing a repair. 

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.10

Major Features

Added the airship tilt controller. Enabling the tilt controller causes your vertical propulsion to control ship pitch rather than vertical thrust.

Autohammers draw 200 pressure if their weapon group was active in the last 1.25 seconds and they have not repaired in the last 10 seconds. (Autohammers already draw 800 pressure for 10 seconds after repairing).

Minor Features

Added the armored half drum balloon.

Added the airship roll corrector. This component will attempt to roll your ship upright when its weapon group is active.

Reduced the torque applied by ballasts.

Reworked the ballast torque negation method. Some ships may now tilt or not tilt when ascending/descending when they previously did not.

Improved the speed and reliability of the server browser.

Added a new installation on horizon with a deadly fort. This installation's ships were built by community member Radolth.

Undefeated installation ships are marked on the compass when nearby.

Adjusted contract and installation rewards to better match the difficulty of mining or looting the reward resource. Aetherium and wood rewards are unchanged while others are lowered.

Added some of the new installation AI ships as hunt quarries.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the hangar stats for large armored balloons listing a lower lift value.

Fixed not being able to loot resource caches in solo expedition.

Fixed AI rams counting as player damage.

Fixed other players sliding into position when respawning.

Fixed non dedicated hosts of expedition not appearing in the server browser.

Fixed joining servers by steam friends or steam invites not functioning.

Fixed not spawning on your captain's original homeship sometimes.

Fixed single auto turrets not showing draw percentage in their hangar mouse over tool tip.

notes.title: Airmen 1.12.9: Enemy Installations
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/fc5f82cd81c48b5f5bf1e9264c9bddf700294ed3.png

Enemy installations arrive at the archipelago this update. Installations are a new way to encounter enemy AI in larger numbers than ever. Installations are groupings of up to 7 forts, outposts, or airships that spawn across the map randomly. The difficulty and rewards for defeating installations rise based on the mass of ships allied to the ship that spawns it. Rewards for defeating an installation can be claimed from resources caches marked in your HUD and are distributed to all allied teams.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b7cb32b5e7dd9a7a4c54ffbd018ebd088dd7790c.png

1.12.9

Major Features

Added enemy installations. Installations spawn across the archipelago and feature a group of forts, outposts, and airships. Installations also spawn resource caches that unlock when all installation ships are defeated. Harder installations with higher rewards spawn for higher amounts of allied ship mass.

Minor Features

Mousing over map markers will display relevant text at the bottom of the map such as island names or contract fort names.

Shrunk and enlarged some island map markers for better clarity.

Bug Fixes

Fixed Mechalodon drones intended to target players never deploying.

Fixed drone bays not deploying drones until their target changes if their only deployed drone is destroyed.

Fixed player firearms doing critical damage to some parts in some locations. Notably this includes the Mechaldon drone.

Fixed siege ships not syncing their bounty when spawned.

Fixed some siege fort parts spawning discolored and infinitely repairable.

Fixed sometimes failing to load into a siege in solo expedition.

Fixed the player's fort disappearing when transitioning to a solo expedition.

Fixed the visual spark effect of planting a boarding charge.

Fixed jittering of the firearm part hit spark effect.

Fixed sometimes spawning off the map when you have a fort already present or are bringing a fort.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.8: Mechalodon Rewards and Improvements
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/98c361c22bfb5aa914758e5d25a4a602cbb58935.png

This weeks's update unlocks the final form of the Mechalodon. Everyone's relentless slaughter of the innocent sea creature has (hopefully) helped iron out the last of its issues and its back with a vengeance. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/19220da92ba19b8822529aec66afb7124942d51d.png

The seafaring kaiju has picked up some new tricks over the week but primarily a fleshed out reward system. Destroying any of the Mechalodon's vitals now provides a resources reward to every attacking crew and a new quest series can be completed to unlock cosmetics and a unique pontoon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/397b15b21174b9dd13d6efe5e53cefb6dee60a82.png

Other changes clean up miscellaneous bugs, further improve airship rendering performance, and rein in the indomitable pressure wells with a damage-causes-drain mechanic.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.8

Major Features

The Mechalodon gives a resource reward for every part destroyed before its destruction rather than a single reward at destruction. The reward also contains resources other than Arcenite depending on the part destroyed.

Added new cosmetic rewards for Mechalodon related challenges.

Added the domestic Mechalodon, a reward for completing the Mechalodon Mastery quest.

Performance improvements for rendering airships.

Minor Features

The Mechalodon corpse will despawn after 2 minutes.

Removed the glowing barrel effect on fixed cannons. This caused performance issues.

The angular velocity cap scales down with mass.

Improved drone laser visuals.

Swapped the Mechalodon drone for a new unique variant. This version has higher damage output, is more durable, and features a large critical spot on its back.

Increased Mechalodon lance damage.

Increased the amount of parts the Mechalodon can hit with its nose ram.

Some of the Mechalodon drones will target nearby players.

Reduced vertical axis drag torque cause by buoyancy parts in water.

Bug Fixes

Fixed drones not arcing out of deploying.

Fixed dying while mining nitranite causing instant recoil on the next weapon swing.

Fixed dead body parts spawning at high speeds.

Fixed the Mechalodon sometimes ramming its own parts.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.7: The Mechalodon and Water Improvements
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/1b9c4297a8e45f272ef47c5df58a89702785a4e8.png

The Mechalodon is on the loose in Airmen 1.12.7. The Mechalodon is a new boss tier enemy you can challenge by ringing the summoning bell on Table. This boss is unlike any other airship encounterable on the archipelago and will use a massive drone swarm, a unique missile variant, its own body as a ram, and its ability to dive deep below the sea.

While the Mechalodon may be accessible this update it still requires further development. Its difficulty will be tuned along with additional rewards beyond posterity.

To complement the watery grave many airmen will meet at the jaws of the Mechalodon, a number of improvements have been made to water related systems. The improved undersea visibility coupled with the tripled ocean depth will be a powerful tool for submersibles so be sure to watch the seas along with the skies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/01ffe0aa6b13e53117a272e175b656dea704fed6.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.7

Major Features

Added a new boss encounter, the Mechalodon. This encounter is in a very early stage and still needs its difficulty and stability thoroughly tested. Once this point is reached, rewards for killing it will be added.

Open ocean is now three times as deep.

Minor Features

Improved submersion transition effect to prevent being under the waves but capable of seeing perfectly.

Increased underwater visibility distance by a factor of 4.

The underwater effect gets darker at night.

Added ambient ocean noises.

The ghost ship can be summoned whenever there is no an existing ghost ship rather than every few days.

Bug Fixes

Fixed distant fog incorrectly shading the skybox at high altitude. 

Removed a problematic ship from the Copse siege that disappeared and caused collision errors after being damaged.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.6: Sandbox Functions and Player Fort Contracts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8ff158324b91f9e21e01e0223150e520e9bc6358.png

Player fort contracts help bring fort development back on track by allowing players to equip their forts with contract boards for each of the three contract types. These special contracts function like any other but do not grant fort reputation. Any captain can grab contracts from these special boards so be sure to share!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/5a93dad0e67d0e4a46138ccf5916e17c8a1559bb.png

A whole slew of sandbox features are now accessible through a new small window in the menus. These new features cover some existing capabilities such as spawning AI, add user interface for some chat only functions such as spawning any saved ship, and add new functions such as spawning ships on your camera position and adding AI gunners.

Ally functionally is also expanded with some small features. Mutual allies can now repair each other and activate ship parts in a timely manner. Allied ships gain a special shield icon instead of a circular blip. 

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.6

Major Features

Added a sandbox function menu to spawn ships and more.

Added contract boards for forts.

Minor Features

Added aggressive and defensive targeting orders to the captain orders menu.

Added ship markers for allied airships.

Taking a contract now only rerolls the contract in the slot taken from, rather than all the contracts in the fort.

Player ships with bounties now display the amount above their ship marker.

Mutually allied teams can now repair each other and activate their ship components at full speed.

Bug Fixes

Fixed Dragon Tails animating in the reverse direction.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.5: Small Armored Balloon and Siege Changes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d341d60370d0186e33342a01baa77528b8b9bcd9.png

This will open up sieges to new players unwilling to risk resources or unable to build a ship sturdy enough to survive the archipelago.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/e90ae8675783ec5d4a976cb5fc3bc7a4386e2a5c.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.5

Major Features

Sieges are now started by opting into one in the lobby. Siege players spawn on the siege fort as their homeship.

Minor Features

Small performance improvement for rending airships.

Improved camera movement smoothness.

Added small armor skinning and small armored balloons.

Bug Fixes

Fixed some square rudders breaking the builder when shifted.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.4: Custom Shares
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/a21a2de8521baacbeaec63a83959d78df9d7ae6d.png

Airmen 1.12.4 brings new parts, new cosmetics, new quests, a new island, a popularly requested lobby feature. Captains can now adjust the share count they and crew members will receive. Captains can set share counts between 0 and 5 for themselves and the crew.

This update also crams a new island between Glacier and Ridgeline. The island favors spawning drone equipped enemies. Be sure to swing by and explore to unlock the new cosmetics added this update.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.3: Quests and Nitranite Refinery
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f5f0afd80bf702b1d71803b2bead97e4a6944a87.png

This week's update introduces the quest system. The quest system will be expanded in the future to cover more elements of gameplay and involve more rewarding less tutorial focused objectives.

The nitranite refinery is also being added to continue the slow creep of fort related features and functionality. More refineries and more features like contract boards will be coming to player forts soon.

Minor Features

Updated engine version for improved performance.

Reorganized the battle menus.

Removed the meaningless time column from the server browser.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.2: Resource Refineries and Delivery Rework
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/ebdda50f339b85d09cfe75d42dce8bdd41746fd9.png

This update introduces the first two resource refineries: the Aetherium Hardener and Wood Petrifier. These fort exclusive parts can be loaded with raw resource parcels to output their refined varieties at a one-to-one ratio. Refineries can store up to three parcels but the finished product must be manually removed before the next refining process begins. Each refinery is uniquely shaped to encourage clever building strategies to maximize resource refining speeds. 

Resource refining should open up a new twist on late-game resource collection, hopefully turning the slowest and safest collection strategy of mining into a high yield operation. Remaining refinery varieties will be added over coming updates.

Delivery contracts are receiving a rework with this update to be more accessible. Many players did not understand why they had to cost gold and avoided them so the reason they needed to cost gold is being removed. Delivery contracts now load your ship with a wide variety of playfully named valueless materials. Extracting your deliverable will give you nothing and you can't get them anywhere else so keep them safe. Deliveries will no longer function as a high yield reward for collecting bounties and are now an easily repeatable highly accessible activity.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.2

Major Features

Added wood and aetherium refinery researches for forts.

Minor Features

Deliveries now load your ship with valueless cargo and no longer cost gold.

Reworked the soft height ceiling to more consistent between ships with different vertical force potential. The soft height ceiling can no longer be "pushed against" but ships with momentum will be able to fly above it temporarily.

Added small variance to contract reward size.

Bug Fixes

Fixed boats easily losing stability.

Fixed unresearched parts not being highlighted after failed hangar verification.

Fixed teleportation node being invisible on potato settings.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.1: Player Forts Part 1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/56fac8a4e8f830f294160e156936a2afef7d5254.png

Player Forts Part 1 brings the core implementation of player forts ready to be expanded. These forts are intended as an extension of the core gameplay most accessible after existing content has been mastered. Forts come at massively higher resource costs than airships but as more content releases to supplement them, these resource costs will be alleviated by increased gains.

Currently, your fort can be used as a mobile operations center. You can spawn into the archipelago alongside your fort and even leave it on a persistent server to spawn in at later. Your fort can teleport around the islands of the archipelago and even bring along nearby ships. The teleporter can also extract the fort, its cargo, and your original home ship.

While waiting for new player fort features like resource refining and contracts, there are still plenty of ways to use your fort to maximize you stockpile gains:

Take on high difficulty contracts and teleport to their destinations with massive firepower.

Build a fort with massive cargo capacity and safely strip mine an entire island.

Teleport nearby a rival fort and wage battle across the island.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.1

Major Features

Added player forts.

Minor Features

Removed lobby contracts and replaced them with fort selection.

Increased all stockpile resource caps to 100000.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that could delete a player's ship before they finished spawning in.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.12.0: Motion Blur, Extended Beams, and Upcoming Player Forts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8e4c879e35370fcc194f0787ff741722d28eeb2e.png

Airmen 1.12.0 brings multiple new and improved optional post processing effects. You can now enable motion blur, screen space reflection, and a fixed ambient occlusion to spice up your visual experience. Additionally, you can now increase you're field of view from the default 60 degrees up to 90.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d22dec847c7c172ab2a00542d34bc108dda0c652.png

This week's update also includes some subtle changes to help get new builders moving in the right direction. Typically ship designs must pack parts together as tightly as possible for many reasons. A major reason to pack parts is to conserve the mass you'd need to connect them. The new extended beams help navigate this by allowing for a simple mass efficient way to span a long distance.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c4f8add8fdbc066c5087d7f05c62465a231c05da.png

Along with the new beams, "armor" parts have been renamed to "hull". Many players tend to over use armor early in a build and break their mass budget while still missing many critical parts. The new name should help some new builders understand the intended function of the parts. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9cf1e3aa474a318277bf5100253e583404b14ca4.png

Finally over the next few updates player air forts will appear across the archipelago. These forts will serve as later game content being geared towards extending the gameplay. Your fort will require greater quantities of resources but at the same time add utilities that increase your resource gain rates. You'll be able to teleport your fort across the archipelago using a new fort exclusive part to take advantage of its many benefits:

Spawn in with both a fort and an airship.

Refine parcels to their high density versions.

Take contracts and extract cargo.

Leave your fort on the archipelago and spawn back in at it later.

and more in future updates...


Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.12.0

Major Features

Added toggleable ambient occlusion.

Added toggleable screen space reflections.

Added toggleable motion blur.

Added an FOV slider.

Minor Features

Improved the bloom effect.

Added extended beams of length 3, 4 and 5.

Added a blue connection surface to the top of the armor edge inner.

Added high density parcels. You can find these on cargo ships and forts.

Added a pressure well category in the parts menus.

Renamed armor to hull.

Renamed the structure category to beam.

Added the resource Arcenite for later use.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that prevented harpoons from being destroyed by melee weapons.

Fixed escort HUD markers not aligning properly.

Restored the brightness slider.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.10: Demo Drones and Single Auto Turrets
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/fe5dc8e2de043c5b17c75b8897302af6c3d6c7ce.png

Airmen 1.11.10 adds a series of new parts. Single auto turrets expand your armament options. The single auto turrets use only one cannon but can rotate 360 degrees compared to their double counterpart's 40 degrees. These turrets will help highly mobile ships take better advantage of their mobility and help lower mobility ships keep up with higher mobility ones. 

Ballast balloon options are both expanded and reworked. Their mass and ballast force is increased to match volume costs of normal ballasts. The new ballast rod balloons also follow this relationship and scale it down in size. Regular ballasts have also had their mass decreased to compete with the ease of using the ballast balloons.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8cf7c8f395442c55bb77d8618ae32d5961eab284.png

If you've grown tired of your ship disintegrating at the hands of laser drones, it can now be demolished by the new Demolition Drone. Demo drones charge directly at their target engine and attempt evasive maneuvers by bobbing up and down along the way. Unlike laser drones, demo drones will be instantly destroyed by any firearm hit. You can encounter the demo drones across the archipelago and in hunt contracts.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f1d966b05ff51c7bbc51c559a20e602284ded098.png

Finally, to ease the learning curve of the airship building system, parts preventing placement are highlighted in red. Building hitboxes are a slow part of the game to learn but an incredibly important one. This system helps a lot with the new single auto turrets as their 360 degree rotation creates a large hitbox.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.11.10

Major Features

Added demolition drones. These drones have 20 HP and a larger hitbox but will bob up and down in an attempt to dodge.

Added a new variant of auto turret with one cannon and 360 degree rotation.

When parts are blocking placement, the obstructing parts will be highlighted in red.

Minor Features

Added two hybrid rod balloons.

Reduced laser drone hp from 220 to 100. Increased laser drone spawn time to 15 seconds. Increased laser drone bay HP by 500.

Drones will not deploy if the drone would immediately crash back into the bay.

Added 9 AI ships equipped with demo drones.

When attempting to return scrap to a scrap box with no scrap or to a full box, it will be taken instead.

Reduced the firepower of autoturrets from 3600 to 3000.

Increased breach cannon magazine size from 3 to 5.

Utility pressure is not counted in the max draw and max draw percent stat in the hangar.

Decreased the mass of ballasts from 50 to 40.

Increased the amount of base thrust provided by sails when misaligned from 14% to 30%.

Increased the mass, pressure cost, and ballast force of the hybrid balloon.

Reduced size of the siege storm.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that prevented the weather from being clear.

Fixed the thrust value in the hangar for the twin propeller.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.9: AI Drone Swarms
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d7cbcb3107d731102c5865698536dca4d638f6a1.png

Airmen 1.11.9 brushes the dust off your revolver, carbine, and lever action with AI drone swarms. Drones are a new AI exclusive weapon you can now randomly encounter across the Archipelago. They will launch from their deployment bays and revolve around your ship firing at your engines. 

The goal with drones is to open up a new form of interaction with AI enemies and to bring unused game mechanics back into relevance. Let me know how it feels to fight the AI armed with drones both as a solo captain and as a crew.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d00e0bfa0091e7951b8ccf7b97c28acf559b3774.png

Drones are most easily destroyed using the accuracy of firearms. Hitting the eyes of the drones will inflict a critical hit with damage varying depending on the weapon used. Drones will also be destroyed when colliding with ships or terrain but will try their best to reverse direction before impact. Destroying the drone bay will also caused all spawned drones to immediately detonate.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c249815279e271ebd924d8a164bf7d5bc31a4421.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.11.9

Major Features

Added AI drone swarms. AI ships with drone deployers will launch small drones that circle their target until destroyed.

Minor Features

When an AI turret hits its own ship, it will stop firing until it does another clear shot check.

Added 3 new hunt contract ships using drones.

Added 6 new island spawns using drones.

Bug Fixes

Fixed AI turrets not changing targets when the target becomes an ally until another enemy is detected.

Fixed AI ships giving bounty instead of rewarding gold when defeated.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.8: AI Changes and Performance Optimizations
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/2825e4acef55b98066cdcaf65725ce421f38f9c9.jpg

In the ongoing effort to increase the pacing of Expedition, the AI are undergoing an extreme alteration. Rather than their 50% damage nerf, they will receive a 50% HP nerf to all components. Fights with AI should play out much faster now and crew mates can feel more effective focusing on dealing damage rather than mitigating it with repairs. The change will also help slash the amount of time spent trying to finish off nearly defeated enemies. More challenging enemies will have their HP reduced by a smaller fraction and may also receive a small damage bonus.

This week's update focused on making some performance improvements, specifically geared towards situations with many ships and AI controlled turrets. The AI targeting algorithm has been overhauled so keep an eye out for turrets not firing when they should. The airship manager script has also had some changes to improve the performance of the thrust limiting effect so you may notice your ship point turning at different speed than before. 

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.11.8

Major Features

Changed AI ships to have 50% reduced part hp rather than 50% reduced damage by default. Hunt contract ships have 25% less HP.

Minor Features

General performance improvements.

Added a new C rank hunt quarry.

Bug Fixes

Fixed hunt contracts not surviving a local host transition.

Fixed a bug that allowed a skull bounty to be collected multiple times.

Fixed part HP resetting to maximum when starting a local host.

Fixed a bug that caused scrap boxes to show the wrong amount of boxes.

Fixed a bug that caused ally state to not appear synchronized until the scoreboard updates when connecting to a match.

Fixed weird noises playing when transitioning between the lobby and an expedition.

notes.title: Airmen 1.11.7: Dynamic Weather
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b13b5a16a1e581db593887bacd12c473a60e4afb.png

Airmen 1.11.7 expands the visual variety of the Archipelago by adding weather that changes over time. Six new weathers have been added to expand on the current two (rain and clear) including heavy rain, overcast, light fog, heavy fog, snow, and heavy snow.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/55ffa5a1457135865db934662853450323e9e0f8.png

1.11.7

Major Features

Added dynamic weather to expedition. New weather types include heavy rain, overcast, fog, light snow and heavy snow. The weather will change randomly during the day and is configured for the selected weather type to be active for one in-game day on average.

Minor Features

Added a new siege to Copse featuring ships built by Storbmaw.

AI turrets will manage their heat levels to be more accurate when targeting a distant enemy.

Replaced the part filter with a search bar.

Improved performance of cell transitioning.

The siege storm is now heavy rain instead of the original light rain. Entering the siege storm will override the current weather conditions.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that could lock the player in chat controls while also hiding chat.
