notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.6: Auto Hammer and the Spookening
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d8d90e24ec21066bc41063b6c0f93d325c382588.jpg

Today's update marks the beginning of Airmen's Halloween tradition: The Spookening. This update adds a batch of scary new cosmetics and allows all previously added Spookening cosmetics to be unlocked for the duration of the event.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8ec28b3736710a8f33763a329c683922e352c5de.png

This year's Spookening adds the Black Knight set. Clad your airman in shiny black and gold armor and strike terror into the hearts of those that would challenge you. A ghostly pirate hat has also been added to match those who've completed the secret challenge to unlock the ghostly shoulder pigeon.

The Spookening cosmetics are all unlocked at the Blood Obelisk located on Horizon. Completing a pact of each difficulty will unlock each component of the Black Knight set and achieving maximum favor will unlock the ghost pirate hat. Bring a hearty vessel and brave crew mates to defeat the dread ships that will stand in your way.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/3f49b1543a3ca133764ea17bf86396dfaaf75c0b.jpg

Beyond the Spookening themed features of this update is an all new powerful component: the auto hammer. The auto hammer is a new ship component that will consume scrap loaded into it to repair nearby connected components. The goal of the component is to give solo captains access to repairs they would otherwise need human crew to obtain. The component itself however is very powerful and will likely become a must have on well built ships so prepare to update all your favorite vessels.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.11.6

Major Features

Added the auto hammer module. The auto hammer expends scrap stored inside to repair nearby connected parts. The auto hammer comes in an A and B variant for mounting on armor plate or beam connections.

Minor Features

Improved game sync speed when ships are highly damaged.

All contracts now have a chance of spawning as ghost ships at night.

Added a spooky obelisk to Horizon. Forge and complete pacts with the obelisk to hunt down scary ghost ships and unlock new cosmetics.

Bug Fixes

Fixed some cosmetics not appearing on the airman.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.5: Automatic Rehosting
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/61fb6c6c23dd34d5beeede2cabaa5cffc8510942.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This weak's update brings a big quality of life and accessibility change to expedition: if you lose connection to the server for any reason, the game will automatically and seamlessly launch a solo expedition. The intention of this feature is to lessen the frustration and penalties of an insufficient connection to the server. This feature is very complex and comes along with all of the issues solo expedition is still hiding and likely more. If you end up using the automatic rehosting while playing please check in to let me know if it worked for you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/be458e97360d76fa18aa90baba05363bf33a9ec6.jpg

Automatic rehosting required most of this week's development time, but you'll also notice some small improvements to the terrain shader. Subtle grass, rock, and sand texturing has been added and the blending texture improved. If you find these improvements to cost you too much performance, you can switch to the old terrain shader in the settings menu.

Next update marks the beginning of this year's Spookening. Ready your scariest ship and creepiest crew to unlock spooky new cosmetics!

1.11.5

Major Features

When server connection is lost during an online expedition, an offline expedition will start seamlessly.

Minor Features

Updated the terrain shader. You can choose quality levels in the hangar settings menu.

Updated trees and added wind effects to them in expedition.

Bug Fixes

Fixed cargo ships sometimes spawning with a bounty and not shooting back.

Fixed harvest and delivery contracts not distributing their resource reward.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.4: Skull Bounties
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/b111f3e6c97033c2251a95f9616e9a35a8c809b0.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Put on your pirate pantaloons for this update's addition of skull bounties. Skull bounties are a new expansion to expedition PvP. You can take on a skull bounty by adding the black flag to your ship. If a skull bounty ship destroys another skull bounty ship, it will receive the full build cost of the destroyed ship as a reward in addition to whatever bounty the ship collected. Ships using the black flag receive no free resources. The approximate location of all skull bounty ships are visible on the minimap.

The goal of the new skull bounty system is incentivize PvP without directing it towards players uninterested in PvP. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/a3edb9684bc1a73c4aed147b8ea2839984ec33b1.png

This update also adds two small features to help new players overcome early hurdles. First, when a ship fails verification in the hangar, the offending parts are made obvious so a new builder wouldn't need to start over to fix any issues. Second, all expedition objectives can now be clicked on to open a tool tip with information describing how to complete them. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/0988dc8cd93ae5a2189467169104cc89dce918f4.png

1.11.4

Major Features

Added skull bounties. You can take on a skull bounty by adding the black flag to your ship.

Minor Features

Doubled siege rewards.

Activating an in-progress siege antennae will register your team to receive shares of the reward when the wave is complete.

Added a 30 second damage lockout on fort extraction.

Ships without at least one engine or pressure well cannot extract. You will receive a message in chat if you attempt to extract such a ship.

Replaced the solo siege button with a solo expedition button. You can now launch and play expedition locally.

Added objective description popups when you click on objective panels in the TAB menu.

When verification fails in the hangar, overlapping parts will be highlighted in red and valid parts will be made transparent.

Bug Fixes

Fixed AI turrets firing while not looking at their target.

Fixed deep stripe colors not appearing on ships for players that connect after the ship is built.

Fixed the client's turret body not matching their cosmetics.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.2: Two New Contract Forts and Expedition Length Reduction
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/530eb5fa09cfec7a2ab0b699633c6b50abfa884c.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

A major goal of this week's update is to reduce the amount of time it takes to complete an Expedition without affecting the individual activities you do during an Expedition. This means cutting out or reducing dead time such as waiting on jet streams, heading for extraction, or going to pick up contracts. The major effort has been made in allowing players to both start and end their Expedition from any of the three contract forts on the Archipelago. All top speed ships are roughly 2 m/s faster to help cut down regular travel times, and forts give contracts for nearby islands only.

1.11.2

Major Features

Added a new contract fort: Tower Reckongale. Tower Reckongale specializes in hunt contracts, with up to 8 contracts to choose from at max reputation.

Added a new contract fort: Tsuchev Ruins. Tsuchev Ruins specializes in delivery contracts with up to 8 contracts to choose from at max reputation.

Minor Features

Increased the speed of all ships by 2 m/s.

Increased the top speed of jet streams and mag drives by 5 m/s.

You will spawn next to a contract fort if one has no nearby players.

Removed the reputation level requirement to extract from a fort.

Forts will not give contracts with distant destinations.

You can repair your ship from the special actions board at contract forts for 3 gold.

Removed all hostile island ship spawns on contract fort islands.

Improved rudder handling to avoid spinning out the ship when transitioning from a rudder turn to a point turn.

Added map markers for each fort.

Tweaked the underwater shader so deep things are not more easily visible when the camera is less deep.

Cargo ships will only target player ships with a bounty on them.

Tweaked the rain particle.

Bug Fixes

Fixed rudders slightly reducing point turn speeds.

Fixed cargo extraction not updating reputation status.

Fixed contracts double collecting resources from the same contract.

Fixed 3rd person player models rubber banding when on a pilot seat and moving at high speeds.

Fixed player hitboxes sometimes lagging behind on fast moving ships for the purposes of player firearm attack hit detection.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.1: Balloon Stripes and Armor Paint

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.11.0: Contract Forts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/0fa96d07280055c405787d1e44e8799632e3294f.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Contracts Forts introduce a new method and benefit of completing contracts in expedition. The Contract Fort feature is not yet fully implemented so hold tight for more content rolling out of the weekend. 

Currently, a single Contract Fort can be found on the Archipelago on Harbor. From the fort you can accept contracts posted on multiple notice boards spread around the fort. Completing the contracts will given you the normal reward of resources and reputation at the fort they were completed for. Reputation has no function currently but within next week it will unlock special benefits and actions at the fort such as ship extraction, better contract rewards, cargo extraction, and more. Additional forts added in the future will have new looks, locations, and benefits for improving your reputation with them.

This update also brings some heavy gatling gun changes. The weapon has proven it is capable of winning a fight in a single successful application. Defeating a gatling gun ship requires avoiding their fire for the entire fight. Previously, this was balanced out by making the weapon highly situational with low range but the nature of expedition mode and other changes such as pursuit bonus and cannon damage falloff have allowed gatling ships to avoid their situational drawbacks. The changes aim to both make gatling guns useful in more situations with range and accuracy increases and to pull back their massive DPS (previous 3-4x greater than any other weapon) with damage and fire rate reductions.

1.11.0

Major Features

Added a Contract Fortress to Harbor where you can take additional contracts up to 4. Completing contracts for the fort increases your reputation with it up to level 18. Accepting a contract will reroll all contracts of the same type.

Added harvest contracts. Harvest contracts can only be started from a Contract Fort and require bringing a designated amount of resources to the fort for a reward of a different resource.

Minor Features

Hunt contracts only spawn one enemy airship of scaling difficult.

Hunt contracts cost no gold.

Easy deliveries now only require delivery.

Contracts are more likely to use aetherium, cyprium, magnesite, and nitranite.

Cargo from the same source activity type will combine into one entry in the post-expedition cargo breakdown. 

Decreased gatling gun damage by 33%.

Increased gatling gun range by 20%.

Increased gatling gun accuracy by 20%.

Decreased gatling gun fire rate by 20%.

Decreased firepower cost of all gatling weapons to equal other weapons in the same form.

notes.title: Airmen 1.10.5: Sail and Balloon Dye
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8cce1461d324503aac76721c527bb6d81a2a38bf.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.10.5 opens up a new form of airship customization with balloon and sail dyes. You will be able to choose a ship-wide color for your sails and balloons individually from the cosmetic menu. You can unlock all the colors by finding their flowers on the Archipelago. Picking three beds of one color will unlock the dye for both sails and balloons. Each color of flower appears in one location on the Archipelago in groups of around six beds. The flowers are hard to spot from a distance so have a spyglass researched and ready!

The balloon/sail dye system also lays the framework for replacing all other colors on an airship. Future color options for the armor brown, for example, are possible. New colors options will not deviate far from the existing styles as it is important to maintain the visual integrity of airships and distinguishability of individual components to prevent color from providing combat benefit.

1.10.5

Major Features

Added unlockable sail and balloon colors. The captain's cosmetic choice will be applied in expedition mode. Siege forts spawned by a team will match their flag ship's cosmetics. Dyes are unlocked by finding matching flowers across the archipelago.

Minor Features

Scoreboard alliance markers will be half full if only one side has marked the other as an ally.

Modified the terrain of Atoll, Cauldron, Horizon, and Ridgeline with a new cavern/valley.

Greatly reduced stutter created by finishing and airship spawn.

Removed color stripe from airships to not conflict with player cosmetic selections. 

Reduced performance impact of missiles.

Slightly improved the performance of the part shading algorithm.

Slightly improved performance when looking at distant islands with clouds.

You will have to resave your own airships to take advantage of the reduced file size for personal storage but the old format is still fully compatible and automatically converted for use in-game.

Parts with any amount of damage will be shaded 15% black and will scale to 100% at 0 hp.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.10.3: Research Shortcuts and Large Armored Balloons
notes.content:
Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c16427e65e31736f398b7af9c4037ad1f0486bd9.png

Five new parts are available this update with a new feature for unlocking them and other parts. Every research now has a "shortcut challenge". Progressing a research's shortcut reduces the research cost by up to 50%. All research shortcuts are progressed by destroying the parts unlocked from that research using ship weapons or extracting aboard a ship using them. 

There are two main goals of the research shortcut system, the first is to speed up research for players less familiar to the game. If you don't know what you are doing, collecting resources can be very slow. The secondary goal is to entice new players into combat with AI aboard their own ship or more experienced players' ships. This will hopefully get new players familiar with the very high rewards of the gold earned in combat or the resources from siege waves.

This update also brings a variety of new components. The large armored balloons further explore the durable lift options and introduce an all new connection scheme compared to existing balloons. 

The new submersibles use the same scheme and shape but expand on watercraft. Submersibles function more similarly to balloons but only in water. Submersibles do not apply a constant upward force like pontoons so combined with ballasts can easily dive below the waves.

Finally, the engine propeller combines propulsion and pressure generation into one component. The propeller has the same stats as the single prop and its built in engine covers ~60% of its pressure cost. The component is highly space efficient but pays for it in mass. Purely replacing normal propellers will likely not be an effective implementation if additional engines and the structure attaching them cannot be removed.

1.10.3

Major Features

Added the engine propeller. A propeller with a small integrated engine.

Added large armored balloon drum and cap.

Added submersible drum and cap.

Added research shortcuts. Extracting or destroying a unresearched component decreases the cost of the research.

Minor Features

Added descriptive text to main menu options if tooltips are enabled.

Picking up a parcel with a grappling gun partially refunds its cooldown.

Attempting to equip a tool with a full inventory shows a notification if tooltips are enabled.

Reduced drag coefficient of the armored balloon to 1.2 from 1.4.

Bug Fixes

Harpoons now behave correctly when attached to minable resources.

Fixed a bug that could break harpoons if their attached target is destroyed.

Fixed harpoons not syncing when loading into expedition.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.10.2: AI Cargo Ships and a New Main Menu
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/6cd323f32155c55d225006ffe021eb109539b942.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

AI controlled cargo ships arrive at the Archipelago in Airmen 1.10.2. These ships are loaded with up to 80 cargo parcels and spawn in open waters as players move across the map. Be sure to keep a spyglass handy to spot any coming your way. Cargo ships behave differently than regular AI opponents and will continue towards their goal rather than directly engaging attackers so be prepared to move and shoot. 

Many of the new AI cargo ships this update were built by Discord community members including Cristal, Dunawolf, Ailen, Clifer, HelloThere and Mech Hunter. I'm still looking to expand the fleet though so feel free to continue submitting new ships following the guidelines mentioned on the Discord!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c8d80e171dcd35379f79a38ceeec75c6e530605c.png

This update also introduces Airmen's first main menu. Rather than loading directly into the builder, you can get to the action with a big easy-to-click link straight into expedition. The new menu also frees up the responsibilities of the build menus allowing for some additional ship related stats to be more accessible. Most importantly, it massively simplifies the new player experience by presenting clearly defined options rather than thrusting them into the builder without telling them what they're doing or how to do anything else.

1.10.2

Major Features

AI cargo ships will spawn across the open waters of the Archipelago. Cargo ships will hold course and fire rather than engage targets like normal ships. When defeated, they will stop to surrender their loot rather than flee. Attacking cargo ships gives you a bounty.

Added a main menu. Airmen will now launch to a main menu screen where you can quickly enter expedition or the builder. Menus previously linked from within the builder like challenges, cosmetics, and research are now found in the main menu. This empty space will eventually be filled with new building specific functions.

Minor Features

Removed action specific bounty caps so assaulting and defeating bountyless airships can infinitely raise your bounty. You must still have a bounty to increase your bounty from defeating a ship.

Bigger player ships place bigger bounties on attackers when defeated. According to 10 + firepower / 1000. 

When a bounty carrying player's ship is defeated, their normally placed bounty is increased by half of their bounty at the time of defeat.

Small performance improvement rendering nearby islands.

Full pursuit bonus is reached at a shorter range. Max pursuit engagement range changed from 350 meters to 200 meters.

Increased float stone spawn chance.

Added a brightness slider to the settings menu.

Added a brighter nights toggle to the settings menu. This setting boosts ambient light at night by 30%.

Bug Fixes

Fixed engines and pressure wells not dropping smoke screens when destroyed.

Fixed float stone spawning with only 3 hits to destroy (supposed to be 20).

Fixed float stone sometimes being unbreakable and never dropping parcels.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.10.1: Allies and New Cargo Pads
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/1b60ec17e71aa310b82bfc31f1f7d5a87f2c6383.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.10.1 brings a new level of cooperation with the ally system. Any captain can mark any other team as an ally by clicking a member on the scoreboard. Allied teams gain a shield icon at the end of their scoreboard entry. Allied teams are ignored by AI gunners, autoturrets, missiles and mines. The ally system for now is intended to make piloting with friends and taking on the archipelago's bigger challenges as a team more possible.

The ally system is not a way to waive combat with other players. Marking an ally is a one-sided action and has no effect on the actions of enemy teams. For a mutual alliance, both parties must mark each other as allies. Captains can also remove an ally at any time. I'll be looking to expand the system in the future to notify each team if the alliance is either one-sided or mutual.

1.10.1

Major Features

Clicking an enemy name on the scoreboard allows a captain to mark them as an ally. AI gunners, autoturrets, missiles, and mines will not target anyone marked as an ally.

Minor Features

Added cargo cages. Cargo cages have higher durability and more connection points than cargo pads but higher mass and lower accessibility.

Added float stone cargo racks. Float stone cargo racks negate a portion of cargo weight.

When a captain leaves and rejoins his crew, captain privileges will be restored.

When a captain leaves, another crew member will gain captain privileges until the original captain returns.

Captains can kick crew members by clicking their name on the scoreboard.

Bug Fixes

Fixed AI gunners ignoring "target crew" commands.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.10.0: Part Research and Three New Cannons
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9d4b65b96982402118fa5cad48085dfe009b6487.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.10.0 introduces a new major facet to Expedition: Part Research. Most parts in the game are now unlocked by spending resources acquired in Expedition Mode on their relevant research. Most researches unlock multiple similar parts and are chained together through branching grids grouped by component type so you'll be able to focus your efforts on branches that are most important to you.

The research system helps narrow the focus of new players on basic ship building before they are swept away by Airmen's large breadth of component options. The training wheels can slowly come off for player's familiarizing themselves with ship building. Research also provides a new potential goal for players in Expedition while attaching accomplishment to continued play. If you are not a new player and prefer to bypass the research system, you will be given a one time chance to update your research progress to cover all parts added before this update. This check relies on detecting resources in your stockpile so you will not have this option if you have never successfully completed an expedition. You can toggle on "Show Locked Parts" in the hangar settings menu if you would like to experiment in sandbox with parts you have not yet acquired.

The typical research requires around 52 parcels of resources. 52 parcels can be easily collected in just over two runs of the lightest no-cost example cargo ship. Medium airships should have no trouble carrying 52 parcels in one trip and taking on delivery contracts or siege waves can earn you resources even faster. Once you start to leverage the options of Expedition Mode, you should be completing a research every one or two successful trips.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/a9df6d54db1e05c0a969ea176b7e6f400e26dfee.png

This update removes one of the oldest components in the game: the cannon turret. Cannons have been a balancing issue for quite some time. Their dual nature as both a fixed gun and turret gun made it impossible to balance for both. To finally address this issue, the old cannon now only appears as a fixed weapon. The cannon heat-accuracy model has been reworked to complement their new role. Cannons now have a high base inaccuracy with a small increase due to heat for an overall lower max inaccuracy compared to last update.

Filling the hole in everyone's heart after losing the cannon turret are three brand new weapons that all play on my favorite aspects of the cannon turret since creation. The first is the three-shot-burst Needle Cannon. The Needle Cannon has high first shot accuracy but struggles after consistent fire. Splitting its damage across three projectiles makes it highly ineffective against armored targets but a better turret dueler than the twin cannon.

The Volley Cannon has a magazine of highly explosive arcing projectiles. The Volley Cannon excels in shorter ranges where the slow moving shots can be easily hit and overlapped for maximum damage. The more the merrier with the Volley Cannon, it's massive AoE can be easily overlapped with others.

The Breach Cannon takes the torpedo damage model into a turreted form. The Breach Cannon is highly accurate but lacks the scope of the Longneck. Shots from the Breach Cannon damage components behind the point of impacts allowing for extreme effectiveness versus tightly built airships. The tiny magazine of the Breach Cannon makes accuracy incredibly important, so be sure to stay on target.

1.10.0

Major Features

Added airship component research. Research can be unlocked from the research menu and will bar you from using parts until their related research is complete. Research is completed using resources collected in expedition mode.

Added Needle, Volley, and Breach cannon turrets.

Removed plain cannon turrets from the game. Their fixed gun variations are still available.

Minor Features

Reworked twin cannon accuracy bloom.

Reworked cannon accuracy bloom.

Converted all tool cabinets to use the pickaxe cabinet shape.

Added a HUD marker when nearby siege forts.

All double turrets now use a smaller model with the same hitbox as a light turret.

Added a chat window to the custom ship select screen in the expedition lobby.

Bug Fixes

Fixed ghost ships spawning in the day time.

Fixed a bug that allowed forts to spawn AI airships.

Fixed a bug that could fail to sync AI controlled status of other player's airship turrets.

notes.content:

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Sails added this update add an all new way to get your ship moving. Sails bring a few unique qualities to the table compared to props. Unlike propellers, sails have no pressure cost but rely on being manually aligned to the wind by crew to achieve their full thrust potential. Additionally sails aligned with the wind allow ships to reach higher top speeds than they could with props. 

Wind direction on the archipelago can be observed in two ways: small wisps appear around a sail while adjusting it and an arrow on the outside of the steering wheel speedometer. The wind blows in a large circle around the archipelago's center but also has a random element that allows the direction to vary by +/-180 degrees over time.

1.9.6

Major Features

Added sails. Sails provide thrust when unfurled and apply much greater thrust when aligned with the wind. Sails can be angled and unfurled by holding E and using WSAD. You do not need to continue facing the sail after pressing E but you must hold it down. While controlling the sail, wind wisps will appear to display the direction of the wind.

Minor Features

Cut rain and snow performance cost by 50%.

Reworked the thrust limitation curve so destroying the first few propellers is more effective once the limit threshold is passed.

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.5: Player Bounties, Crew Orders, and Float Stone
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/1f1b18cb7416a44bf629bb1d52a356b7555b2dd2.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Bounties

Update 1.9.5 introduces player bounties with the goal of tying a reward to the PvP side of Expedition. The bounty system is carefully designed to turn those interested in PvP on each other rather than further promoting the slaughter of innocent cargo haulers. Bounties are acquired for assaulting bountyless ships and for destroying ships but only if you destroy it while a bounty is on your head. Additionally, any bounty acquired from a bountyless ship cannot increase your bounty beyond 20 gold. Ships with a bounty placed on them can extract for 50% of their bounty in gold or hunt down other pirates to gain an even larger bounty. Destroying or disarming a ship with a bounty allows you to claim 100% of the bounty as gold upon extraction. This system ensure piracy against other pirates is the most lucrative way to PvP, piracy against non pirates is the least, and players who successfully fend off a pirate attacks have something to gain.

Airships with bounties gain a black dot above their airship and any balloon paint also turns to black. This is visible to all players and the dot will be visible from greater distances when using a spyglass.

The existing bounty system might feel a bit unrewarding in its most bare bones form but I am planning to expand on the system with elements like resource rewards and a "pirate king".

Crew Orders

Crew orders while them may seem nice for high player count ships are truly geared towards users relying on AI turrets. AI gunners will obey all targeting commands and when combined with their accuracy improvement this update will exceed the effectiveness of your average human gunner. While the AI may be better gunners that is their only function and a human player can both man a gun and repair the ship between reloads so I do not expect the AI gunners to be valued over a skilled human. I'll be keeping a close eye on this relationship.

Float Stone

Float Stone is a brand new resource spread across the 5 brand new "small islands" added this update. Float Stone orbits in the sky in clusters of up to three. Float Stone can be used to craft Float Stone Shards and Bricks, heavy components that provide a massive amount of lift per volume. The heaviest ships in the game will have no problem being suspended by two float stone bricks. Float Stone lifted ships are slower for this trade off but should be able to protect themselves unlike any other ship given the free space opened up by lacking regular balloons.

1.9.5

Major Features

Added bounties for PvP. Players get bounties when they attack bountyless ships or destroy ships. Destroying bountyless ships can only increase a ship's bounty up to 20 gold. Extracting allows you to claim 50% of your bounty.

Pilots can issue targeting commands to their crew. AI gunners will obey the commands. Autoturrets will ignore targeting commands but will hold fire and reload.

Added float stone as a resource and two new components: float stone brick and float stone shard.

Minor Features

Added a tooltip when you mount the steering wheel.

Collisions are disabled for distant airships.

AI controlled turrets lead moving targets for improved accuracy.

AI airships can target engines, propellers, weapons and balloons.

Added 5 new minor islands: Lookout, Igloo, Tooth, Floes, and Copse.

Added a /cargo command to add cargo to your ship in sandbox.

Moderator forced extraction refunds contract cost.

Parcels can be picked up using the grappling gun.

Picked up parcels are not automatically equipped.

Bug Fixes

notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/357a5882165f8e85ccb60919c2bfa78f82b31f57.png

Hunt Contracts are a new reason to bring your combat ships out onto the archipelago. These contracts place AI airship encounters across the archipelago and for defeating all enemies you'll land a healthy chunk of resources. Hunt quarries spawn when you enter their last known location and their ships are some of the stronger AI and a new and improved selection to flesh out the top ranks. These AI are intended to be significant combat threats so their damage reduction has been peeled back slightly and the "insane" difficulty (previously "very hard") should be next to impossible if you don't find a way to cheese them or bring a well trained crew.

Server stability has been an issue as Expedition picks up steam and becomes more playable. Further fixes have been applied this update that prevent airships from lingering in the server and piling up as players cycle through. Thankfully, the fixes applied earlier this week (that did not make the problems go away) still addressed issues of server stability that would eventually crop up. I'm hoping to put the nail in the coffin here and stop setting alarms to manually reset the server every day.

1.9.3

Major Features

Added Hunt contracts. Hunts reward resources for taking down AI airships at specific locations. Hunted airships have 25% turret damage reduction penalty instead of 50% like regular AI ships.

Minor Features

Added 8 new AI airships as part of hunt contracts only. These ships are designed to be much stronger. Most are upgraded variants of existing ships.

Added more jet streams.

Bug Fixes

Further improvements to server stability.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.2: Contracts and Nitranite
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/02345a0c076980b2352273349d9202a78138f9d6.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update brings contracts to the archipelago. Captains can select and purchase a contract with gold before launching onto the archipelago. Contracts are designed to give more purpose to bigger ships by being difficult or impossible to complete without one and offering higher rewards for completion than standard mining. More contracts types will be added over the weekend and in the future.

Captains can currently choose only "Cargo Delivery" contracts where you are given a batch of resources to drop off at designated points across the archipelago marked on your HUD and by a blue flare. Cargo is automatically unloaded when nearby the delivery point and HUD popups appear when progress is being made. Completing contracts adds the reward directly to your crew's stockpile (no need to extract) and refunds half the contract cost. Higher difficulty contracts have a scaling reward where some more expensive and difficult contracts can offer up to 12000 wood for completion.

Nitranite was added to round out the core resource set. Anything that explodes requires nitranite. You can find nitranite on coastlines. Nitranite is highly volatile and overworking of the ore can cause it to explore so keep an ally with a repair hammer nearby.

The balance changes accompanying contracts aim to bring all heavy weapons into the same playing field. Players should feel like they can choose any one of the heavy weapons and be competitive against any of the others. Giving some of them extreme range advantages or disadvantages ensures players not opting into the longer range weapon have little to no chance of damaging their enemy when one ship has a speed advantage.

Gatling guns and harpoons additionally received minor buffs to help make them feel worth it when you spend the time to close the longer sight lines in Expedition. 

1.9.2

Major Features

Added contracts. Captains can select and purchase a contract before launching onto the archipelago. 

Added Nitranite. Nitranite is a volatile resource found on beaches. Mine at your own risk.

Minor Features

Visually improved the edges of terrain cliffs and shorelines.

Extracting returns half the resource cost of destroyed parts instead of zero.

Added more jetstreams and reversed the direction of a few.

Slightly increased the strength of pursuit bonus speed.

Balance Changes

Increased the range of heavy torpedos to 400 meters.

Decreased the range of rail guns to 400 meters. 

Increased focuser hp to 600.

Decreased the firepower cost of rail gun components so a fully focused rail gun costs 6k firepower.

Decreased harpoon turrets and cannons firepower.

Improved accuracy of harpoons.

Increased gatling gun damage by 5 and decreased armor penetration by 5.

Increased torpedo speed by 10%.

Bug Fixes

Fixed players being unable to captain up if there were too many heavy ships loaded in.

Fixed turret guns being able to fire when the turret is disabled.

Fixed pursuit bonus sometimes applying when travelling in reverse away from an enemy.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.1.2: Framerate Fixes and Expedition Balance Tweaks
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/d2f8ce06c397cefe78d37d8f29f22ea05ede2cf4.jpg

As Expedition Mode becomes more stable, the way people play becomes more apparent and balance problems can be tackled. 

"Hard Points" is a new mechanic aimed a raising the durability of weapons. Most battles seem be a race to de-gun the opponent. There are no direct weapon durability buffs coming yet but the durability of their connection points would be a limiting factor without hard points.

Expedition Mode as is has been fairly uninteractive as human players just flee from fights with any amount of risk. The "Pursuit Speed Bonus" aims to allow either party to choose to fight when the match-up is close to even, rather than the faster ship playing gatekeeper.

Longnecks have proven to be a big issue in a world where there is always somewhere to run. Longneck users no longer have to experience their built-in drawback so they cannot retain their situational strength. These changes aim to force longnecks to compete in the same space as twin cannons. In a 1v1 matchup, a good shot on the longneck can still easily destroy a twin turret but the enemy captain has some more room to make the sniper's job as hard as possible.

Finally, looking towards the future, solo ship play will be getting some attention. The autoturret buff aims to improve the weapon without improving the value of a human player constantly repairing it so solo fliers can feel like autoturrets are a good choice. This won't be the end though; solo players still need a little help. I am looking into adding up to 2 AI turret gunners for ships that have no crew.

1.9.1.2

Major Features

Added "Hard Points". Hard points give hp bonuses (1/3 hard point hp up to 2000 combined) to all connected parts that are not also hard points. Bonus hp is spread evenly to connection points. All weapons besides rams are hardpoints.

Ships get a small speedboost in pursuit of other ships so ships with small mass differentials can both catch up to eachother. "Pursuit Range" begins at 450 meters.

Minor Features

Changed the extraction compass marker to a gold arrow.

Longneck range reduced to 275 (same as twins). Changed the falloff curve so longnecks deal max damage between 125m and 200m. Reduced the projectile speed by 50%. Added a small amount of base inaccuracy.

Increased all autocannon HP to 2000.

Doubled the hp of cargo pads.

Bug Fixes

Fixed being able to bring a ship you cannot afford using the "current ship" option.

Fixed AI airships sometimes temporarily turining off course during cell shifts.

Fixed "FPS holes" that caused massive frame drop when looking in certain directions.

Fixed not being able to kick crew members in lobby.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.1: Expedition Lobby Overhaul
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/521d9fabc01e6aea2947000c9d5b7064d05844fd.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The expedition lobby overhaul massively improves the lobby experience. The UI is reworked with expedition in mind (rather than a team death match like escort mode) and should flow much more naturally for new players. For experienced players, you'll need a few more clicks to get into match but the new "Instant Launch" button should mitigate any extra time needed to get out on the archipelago.

This update also targets AI. Previously, AI were designed around going 1-for-1 in Escort Mode but they have a different purpose in Expedition Mode. AI needs to be a conquerable challenge that instead of destroying the player who puts up a poor fight, wounds them and moves them closer to defeat in their next battle. Fighting AI must be a risk, but the cost of a single failure should not be defeat. To adhere to this ideal, AI turret targeting aggro has been adjusted to be more evenly spread, until an opportunity to deal permanent damage arises. AI turret damage has been slashed by 50% so every fight isn't a fight for your life. Lastly, AI turret range has been extended by 30 meters to eliminate the faster forms of long-range zero-risk victory strategies.

Contracts
The new UI most importantly lays the foundation for more expedition mode features the previous UI had no space for such as Contracts. Contracts are an upcoming expedition mode feature intended to give crews more concrete objectives during their expedition. Before launching, your captain will be able to spend gold to purchase one of a variety of contracts including activities like cargo delivery, AI ship hunts, and fort defense. Completing a contract will reward crews with a large amount of resources.

1.9.1

Major Features

Massively overhauled the user interface for expedition mode lobbies.

Minor Features

Added a Harbor>Ridgeline and Tablet>Cauldron jet stream and reversed the direction of a few to create cyclical pathways. Jet streams to and from every spawn point will be added over the weekend.

Improved AI's ability to chase their target. They will not barely enter range then stop only to go out of range immediately.

AI turret's target focus is random until an engine becomes much lower HP than the others.

AI turrets (NOT autoturrets) deal 50% reduced damage but have slightly extended range (+30m). AI will pilot the same as if they had normal range.

Bug Fixes

Fixed captainless players appearing as spectators after reconnecting.

Fixed a bug where only moderators could set their crew to private.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.0.3: Expedition Fixes, AI Bounties, and Loot Sharing
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/0fec11805c60e167fb7a34c7c42787c9007d7fcd.png

A handful of tweaks and fixes for expedition mode have rolled out over the weekend and this update puts the cherry on top by fixing issues with AI ships not spawning. 

In the upcoming week, the expedition lobby UI will get some overhaul to both create new gameplay possibilities and make getting onto the archipelago as smooth as possible. If everything goes smoothly, there may even be something to do with all the gold you'll get from collecting bounties.

1.9.0.3

Major Features

Added a new cargo ship spawn, fort spawn, and ground outpost.

Defeating AI airships will reward you with a gold bounty that will be split upon extraction. Bounties are split evenly among all ships that damage the AI. Bounties are tied to a ship so extracting with another team's ship will reward you with their bounties.

Minor Features

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.9.0: Expedition Mode Alpha Testing
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/cb42319f14afc1aaf68a01d8fa287882d9604520.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Update 1.9.0 begins live Expedition Mode testing! During the regularly scheduled playtests, the game mode will be changed to Expedition Mode as long as the mode is functioning. Keep in mind, the frameworks supporting this game mode are not yet complete so it may not perform reliably and will certainly be missing a massive number of quality of life features. Features and fixes will be ongoing as the mode is tested.

Choose Your Airship
To captain up in expedition mode you must have enough resources to pay the build cost of your ship. A small amount of each resource will be subtracted from airship build costs so smaller ships can be built for free. The build cost of your ship is listed on a chalkboard on the left of the hangar.

If you don't have a light cargo vessel you can find one on the workshop:
Betty
Trike
Pack Ram

Fill Your Cargo Hold
Once you captain up and load into the archipelago, use the axe and pickaxe to mine resources. Different resources are found in different places. Aetherium is found at high altitudes, cyprium inside forests, and magnesite growing from large magnetic rings.

Mining isn't the only option though. Forts and some ships will be loaded with random cargo so if you can take them down, the resources are yours. Hijacked ships can also be extracted for half their build costs.

Extract
With a full cargo hold its time to cash out. Your extraction point will be marked on your HUD by a black dot. Getting within 50 meters of your extraction point will disconnect you from the game, refund your build cost for any parts not destroyed, and transfer your cargo hold to your stockpile. If you managed to wrangle an enemy airship, you will receive 50% of the build cost but will leave any other ships behind so best have a crew mate extract with it instead.

There are many things left to add/improve for expedition mode but I'm going to lay out some of the more obvious issues that may come up. 

Travelling between islands takes forever. Jet streams will be added so you can catch the wind and speed over to an adjacent land mass. The speed boost will be bigger for bigger (slower) airships.

How many resources do parts cost? Individual part costs will be made visible in the future.

The AI are so annoying. currently, AI without cargo serve purely as road blocks for other resources. The plan is to add a bounty system that transfers resources directly to the stockpiles of any crew that takes them down.


Patch Notes
1.9.0

Major Features

Expedition mode has been unlocked for playtests.

Added a board in the hangar that tells you the resource cost of your airship. These values are not final or complete.

Added cyprium, magnesite, pigeons, and gold resources. Gold can only be looted from cargo holds, cyprium is found near trees, pigeons are gathered through eggs from chopped or shot down branches found on cliff faces and in thin trees, and magnesite grows on large magnets.

AI cargo ships and forts will spawn with cargo.

Minor Features

Improved reconnect reliability for slower connections and weaker computers.

Improved reconnect speed for matches with lots of cargo parcels.

When a fort is defeated reinforcements will sometimes arrive.

Build mode warnings visually "pop" when they appear so they are more noticeable.

Added a warning for when a ship has insufficient pressure to move at full speed.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where firearms could be fired during the equip/unequip animation.

The reconnect overlay no longer blocks the TAB menu.

1.8.9

Major Features

AI airships, watercraft, airforts, and seaforts will spawn as you explore the archipelago.

Minor Features

Resources sync when players reconnect to multiplayer sandbox.

Increased tool board mass from 2 to 3.

Increased torpedo speed by 33%. Max range unchanged at 360 meters.

Fixed a bug where ballasts applied their self-limiting force even when inactive.

Fixed a bug where players could have two bodies if they took damage while on a turret.

Fixed a bug where players were not dismounted from steering wheels when the captain took the wheel.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.6: Mesh Detail Fade
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/14afb828a03b62a48965242e4c227193cc9bf85d.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

In order to fill Expedition mode with meaningful encounters, the game must be able to handle more ships on screen as players across the map battle each other or the AI. Detail Fade helps by using low poly ships at a distance and not rendering them at all at greater distances, so two full-scale battles can occur on opposite ends of the map. Detail fading will also offer some improved performance in existing battles if all ships aren't grouped into a small nearby area.

Next update will overhaul how airship parts are treated over the network which will allow for instantaneous ship spawning and faster reconnect.

1.8.6

Major Features

Airship part mesh quality will lower as they get further for improved performance. Lowering the detail fade setting will use the lower quality models at closer distances for better performance.

Minor Features

Added a pickaxe. The pickaxe is not a combat tool but will be able to mine many of the resources required to build an airship. The cosmetics options will remain locked as they will be tied to resource harvesting.

Escort will go into overtime as long as the point is controlled by one team.

Added a destruction effect to aetherium rocks.

Bug Fixes

Match result text will appear if the player is not in first person camera.

Fixed spectator camera sometimes moving with ships after death.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.4: What is Expedition Mode?
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/063ec94d59c912771d8baaeca897224b4da1acf4.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This week's update comes loaded with bug fixes and a preview of things to come. 

What is Expedition Mode?
Expedition mode is an all new open-ended way to play Airmen. Players will join a lobby, form a crew, select their airship and launch their expedition. On your expedition you'll look to fill your cargo hold with a variety of resources from wood to coal to aetherium to helicore. AI structures and airships may protect resource deposits or other human crews may look to pirate your cargo hold. The map will remain persistent as new crews join and leave and new resources and resistances will be generated as islands are encountered.

Resources
Any cargo you successfully extract with be added to your depot. Resources are spent when choosing a ship to enter expedition mode with based on what parts are used to build the ship. Bringing very light basic airships will cost no resources but the heaviest airships will require multiple successful hauls to amass their components. Successful extraction will refund a ship's resource cost based on the damage it has sustained.

Resources will come in many varieties with multiple ways to harvest each one. Components like pigeon missiles will require unique resource like pigeon eggs but simple armor, beams, and cannons will only require wood and aetherium steel. Aside from vanilla harvesting, resources can be plundered from AI cargo vessels or found in protected caches. Additionally, any captured airship can be extracted and disassembled into a fraction of its build cost.

Development
Expedition mode is a massive project and its functional components will slowly roll out individually. It began with the endless sandbox to test a larger map, then Last Crew Standing to bring that map to multiplayer and create a multi-team framework, and now the ability to chop down trees and load a cargo hold with the dropped resources. Future frameworks include mid-match connection, persistent resource tracking, run-time resource and resistance spawning, and more.

The new mode also requires much more new content on top of technical frameworks including each harvestable resource, new AI structures and airships, and new islands.

The existing game modes of Airmen will remain unaffected in the mean time unless implementing a feature into it would serve as a useful test. You will NOT be required to pay resource costs to bring ships to existing game modes.

This new mode is still a ways out and it will not be officially released until all core framework is implemented and a healthy amount of content can be enjoyed. There will likely be scheduled tests of the new mode coordinated through the Discord as it gets closer to release.

Patch Notes

1.8.4

Major Features

Added small and large cargo pads so you can gets started on your expedition mode cargo vessel.

Chopping down trees with an axe drops resource parcels that can be loaded onto cargo pads.

Minor Features

Made the hitboxes for all armor plates, roots, forks, halves, and planks consistent.

Tightened up the front rudder build and battle hit box.

Added new tree variants to Sandbox, Build Mode, High Tide, and Cauldron.

The danger zone now fully closes in Last Crew Standing.

Improved the tree destruction particle effect.

Bug Fixes

Fixed autoturrets being able to rotate too far down.

Team chat appeared to everyone in Last Crew Standing.

Fixed the railgun particle system not appearing.

Fixed /hide not working if used in a match.

Fixed grass not hiding when the option is toggled on.

Fixed weird white lines sometimes visible underwater near the origin.

Fixed a bug where the player would fall rapidly if they hit a wall after a grapple pull.

Fixed inconsistent danger zone inclusion between different heights.

Major Features

Added small and large cargo pads so you can gets started on your expedition mode cargo vessel.

Chopping down trees with an axe drops resource parcels that can be loaded onto cargo pads.

Minor Features

Made the hitboxes for all armor plates, roots, forks, halves, and planks consistent.

Tightened up the front rudder build and battle hit box.

Added new tree variants to Sandbox, Build Mode, High Tide, and Cauldron.

The danger zone now fully closes in Last Crew Standing.

Improved the tree destruction particle effect.

Bug Fixes

Fixed autoturrets being able to rotate too far down.

Team chat appeared to everyone in Last Crew Standing.

Fixed the railgun particle system not appearing.

Fixed /hide not working if used in a match.

Fixed grass not hiding when the option is toggled on.

Fixed weird white lines sometimes visible underwater near the origin.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.3: Last Crew Standing
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/61817360328912e57a680a3746fbc77499fe568d.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Last Crew Standing is a free-for-all across a 9x9km map with an encroaching storm. Every 2 minutes and 30 seconds the eye of the storm will shrink and the "Danger Zone" will move closer to its final destination. Ships and Airmen in the Danger Zone take damage over time. Added a new game mode: Last Crew Standing. 

Minor Features

Added rain effects. The new rain effects can be seen in LCS mode and on the Cauldron escort map. A rainy build map will be added in the future.

Right mouse button will snap the camera to orbit the nearest airship if the player is permanently dead. 

Bug Fixes

Adjusted the hitbox of the armor plate long to match the armor plate.

Fixed a bug where changing gamemode did not uncaptain AI.

Fixed a bug where a player would be trapped on the respawn screen if their ship lost pressure and they had not selected a chamber.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.2: Endless Sandbox
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8a6b5fb99cb00a3ddec4e1249fa8f94bb98722ea.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.8.2 lays the framework for an all new game mode with infinite map scrolling. Next time you load into sandbox, you'll be able to fly into the distance and visit all other maps. This feature is experimental and is likely to have a few quirks and side effects in other areas of the game, so, if you run into any, please let me know on the Steam forums or Discord.

The goal of the new mode is to build something fun for 1-4 players (but not limited to a number this small) as battles will leave you with the AI as the only opponent or siege mode will be impossible to win without a bigger party. The new mode incorporates all gameplay elements of existing modes but features exploring a map to find and harvest different resources and completing activities and events.

1.8.2

Major Features

Sandbox is now ~4 billion kilometers wide and contains all playable maps. There is nothing to do here (yet) other than explore the old terrains and is currently a test for a new game mode.

Minor Features

Massively improved load time between lobby and match.

Small performance improvement for terrain rendering. This will likely be offset in the new sandbox due to the distant terrains.

Bug Fixes

Fixed lever action cabinet build mode tooltip.

Fixed the challenge name display for lever action bash kills.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.1: Lever Action Rifle
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/755bc08d1243da570b7244f127b9f0170ac11771.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen update 1.8.1 brings an all new firearm: the lever action. The lever action fills the gap between the revolver and the carbine. The lever action fires slightly faster the the carbine at the cost of reduced headshot damage, so much so that the lever action cannot score a one-shot headshot. The magazine is large but bullets must be loaded individually. Finally, moving inaccuracy is greatly reduced compared to the carbine.

1.8.1

Major Features

Added a lever action rifle. The lever action rifle fires faster than the carbine, does the same damage, but deals greatly reduced headshot damage.

Minor Features

Very widely placed props will not apply additional torque. Limit begins at 5 unit offset. Heavy ships naturally take advantage of this and were pivoting much faster than light ships.

Added a new steering wheel option that allows for continuous adjustment of controls.

Increased boarding charge percent hp damage to 55% from 35%.

Ships can only have 3 control stations.

Added chat messages that inform players why their ships fail verification in the lobby.

The revolver starts to reload if you cock the hammer with an empty magazine.

Updated the carbine animations to take up more of the screen.

Updated the carbine inventory icon to be clearly distinguishable from the lever action.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where harpoons fired erratically after hitting a moving ship.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.8.0: Cooperative Building
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/cb56250a1cc04c06ac20f44b5c3c4b53807e419e.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen 1.8 brings one of the most requested features to the hangar: cooperative building. The system works using Steam's built-in networking solution so you can easily drop into a friend's session with no port forwarding required. Users share a hangar space but everything else is independent such as mirror mode, saving, or equipped part. Only the session host can load and dismantle. In the event of hangar desynchronization, simply disconnect and reconnect to repeat the sync process.

1.8.0

Major Features

Added cooperative building. You can join and invite friends using steam. Any number of players can build together.

Minor Features

A popup will appear to prevent interruption of save thumbnail generation.

Uncapped crew per ship.

Added four new cosmetics as rewards for the torpedo and heavy cannon challenges.

Reduced the range of cannons from 216 to 200. 

Increased Range of twin cannons to 275 from 250.

Added distant clouds to the skybox.

Changed fog to apply as a gradient from the ground up so distant ships and clouds will not appear gray against the skybox.

Bug Fixes

Assigning ballasts to weapon groups could cause ships to launch into space if they are activated while the group is disabled.

Fixed a bug where the chalkboards did not reset on dismantle.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.7.2: Torpedo Pods and Heavy Cannons
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/2ba946a454b8e4099485fc21c150f1ddcf036506.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update brings two all new weapons designed around laying down damage on heavier airships. Challenge rewards for both weapons will roll out at a later date.

The torpedo pod fires a slow moving projectile that can crush dense ship unable to dodge in time. As an added bonus, the pod can fire when submerged. 

The heavy cannon fires a long range shot with high inaccuracy so smaller targets can more easily evade. The heavy cannon shot explodes backwards for huge rewards when shots detonate inside the target rather than splashing off the outside.

1.7.2

Major Features

Added a Torpedo Pod. The Torpedo Pod fires a slow-moving projectile long-range that damages targets in a line behind the impact point in a two shot burst.

Added a Heavy Cannon. The Heavy Cannon fires a long-range high-inaccuracy exploding projectile. The heavy cannon cannot reload while the ship is over draw

Minor Features

Gatling cannons will explode on destruction just like regular cannons.

Added an in-game quality selector.

Added a grass toggle setting.

Added a cosmetic toggle setting, this will force other player's cosmetics to the default loadout.

Added welcome popups to the hangar and server browser with a Discord server link. Acknowledging these popups causes them to never appear again.

Added a playtest countdown timer to the server browser.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that allowed ships to ascend into space when damaged if they used both ballasts and upward props.

Hybrid balloons can be assigned a weapon group.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.7.1: Water and Terrain Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/3f272c7ab039e7658a58b1d26441cc586fcd0706.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The terrain update brings in an all new style to all maps excluding Glacier. The new system allows for overhangs, holes, and a massive improvement over the old system. A portion of the performance gains are spent on the new water system with physics intractable waves. Overall, vertex counts in scenes are drastically reduced thanks to the new terrain.

1.7.1

Major Features

Reworked all maps except Glacier to use a new topology system with tunnels and overhangs.

Upgraded water visuals and added waves. Submerged ships will rock on the waves.

Minor Features

High Tide is an all new watercraft map, replacing the Cauldron reskin.

Ballasts now use the same force calculation as upward props. Ships that use ballasts will raise/lower faster as a result.

A small drag force is applied to submerged balloons to help keep watercraft submerged.

Grass now receives shadows.

Raised the sea level on Harbor and Excavation to make them watercraft compatible.

Bug Fixes

Ballasts and upward props were not grouped for the purpose of thrust limiting allowing ships that used both to raise very quickly.

Swapping the map will not change the map selector's value and prevent voting for the chosen map.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.5: Lobby Timer Rework
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c71ed93412437e3230f00dcd6f2b09b22d75b09d.jpg

This week's update is smaller than usual considering my holiday break. No big content additions, just some small fixes and changes to help out new players.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

1.6.5

Major Features

The lobby timer will not tick down if there is not a valid match. The timer will tick faster when a higher fraction readies up and reset if the match becomes invalid.

Minor Features

When you switch to a watercraft on a map that does not support them, you will receive a warning message.

The text next to the match timer will change to let players know if the teams are valid and the match will start.

Enabling tooltips will show the tool slot number next to each tool slot.

Propellors and ballasts can be assigned to weapon groups. Assigned components will be forced into an off state if their assigned group is off.

Ballasts no longer lose upward lift ability when ship mass exceeds lift.

Returning to hangar from sandbox or battle will load the autosave ship and prep the UI to save the last ship loaded. Rather than loading the last ship loaded.

The firepower warning in hangar now clarifies firepower cannot exceed mass.

A message appears in chat when the autosave ship updates.

Updated the tutorial board to describe escort instead of deathmatch.

Added an option to gameplay settings to bind camera y axis rotation to the ship when piloting. 

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug allowing players to bring watercraft to maps that did not support them.

Fixed a bug where your carbine (and sometimes other tools) would stick to the wrong hand in animations.

Fixed a bug were top speed was reported incorrectly if building began before any ship was loaded into the hangar.

Airship forward/backward and turning can be key mapped again.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.4: Pressure Wells and Hit Effects
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f237cb445d14ee0f82cdf5487faf0af14f3ffcbe.png

This week's playtests will be cancelled and moved to December 26th at 7pm ET and December 27th at 12pm ET. Keep an eye out on the Discord though as other community members may still be available at the regular times.

Pressure Wells are an all new pressure providing component. Wells produce no pressure of their own but store any excess output for later use. They start the match charged to full capacity. Ships with powered pressure wells will not be counted out until all pressure is drained.

1.6.4

Major Features

Added pressure wells. Pressure wells absorb unused pressure and output it if the ship cannot generate enough. Pressure wells have no maximum output rate.

Minor Features

Swords attack slower but can make a quick follow up attack by holding down the attack button or clicking again after a short delay.

Ships can be piloted using an xbox controller allowing for analog turning and acceleration.

You can cycle through tool slots with mousewheel. Useables like the grappling hook are skipped.

Small performance improvment rendering clouds and engine steam.

Small performance improvement rendering ships with lots of glass, small/medium engines, or balloons.

Bug Fixes

Pigeon missiles did not prioritize targets with engines over those without.

Player grip did not reset on death in sandbox.

Fixed stabilizers not detecting collisions in the hangar.

Fixed front rudders and dragon tails clipping through terrain.

A ship's pressure status will immediately update when in submerges and unsubmerges.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.4: Pressure Wells and Hit Effects
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/f237cb445d14ee0f82cdf5487faf0af14f3ffcbe.png

This week's playtests will be cancelled and moved to December 26th at 7pm ET and December 27th at 12pm ET. Keep an eye out on the Discord though as other community members may still be available at the regular times.

Pressure Wells are an all new pressure providing component. Wells produce no pressure of their own but store any excess output for later use. They start the match charged to full capacity. Ships with powered pressure wells will not be counted out until all pressure is drained.

1.6.4

Major Features

Added pressure wells. Pressure wells absorb unused pressure and output it if the ship cannot generate enough. Pressure wells have no maximum output rate.

Minor Features

Swords attack slower but can make a quick follow up attack by holding down the attack button or clicking again after a short delay.

Ships can be piloted using an xbox controller allowing for analog turning and acceleration.

You can cycle through tool slots with mousewheel. Useables like the grappling hook are skipped.

Small performance improvment rendering clouds and engine steam.

Small performance improvement rendering ships with lots of glass, small/medium engines, or balloons.

Bug Fixes

Pigeon missiles did not prioritize targets with engines over those without.

Player grip did not reset on death in sandbox.

Fixed stabilizers not detecting collisions in the hangar.

Fixed front rudders and dragon tails clipping through terrain.

A ship's pressure status will immediately update when in submerges and unsubmerges.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.3: Watercraft and Glacier Map
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/532444d0e9f7e0ff4e5e3657cf781f08bbcca34d.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET (NEW TIME), Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Experience an all new class of (sea)ship! On select maps players can now bring watercraft. Watercraft are any ship with sufficient lift to float but not enough to fly. 

To complement the newly added watercraft, an all new map with a watery bottom and sky high glaciers has been added. Small ships can squeeze between the tunnels to escape larger predators.

1.6.3

Major Features

Added a new map (Siege and Escort): Glacier. A new snow map with massive glaciers reaching to the height ceiling and small tunnels cutting through the bases. The capture point is at sea level so watercraft can contest.

Watercraft can now be brought to Sandbox, Glacier and Horizon. Watercraft are any valid airship however their lift only needs to be 25% of mass.

Thrust output per mass is soft capped to reduce the speed of propeller spamming airships. These ships will still accelerate as quickly as they did before.

Minor Features

Added a center of lift indicator to the hangar.

Added a top speed indicator to the hangar chalk boards.

Added a new cosmetic and challenge for winning a match as a watercraft captain.

Added a new watercraft example ship Ex Cruiser.

/savedestination in build mode will output the airship save directory to chat.

Bug Fixes

Mines were locking on before their damage fully ramped (5 seconds early).

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.2: Winter Offensive Wave One
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/6b4692ad73ad6da6f6423585bcc01d744dc3c7cc.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 12pm ET (NEW TIME), Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Wave one of the Winter Offensive rolls out this week with new seasonal weather and cosmetics. New cosmetics are not event exclusive.

Major Features

Snow will fall on snow maps. Airships will also have a snowy dusting.

Added new cosmetics and challenges for the Winter Offensive.

Minor Features

Added snow to sandbox, lobby, build mode, cauldron, and high tide.

Improved the airman hand model.

Changed the armored cabinet tool tip description to convey its soft locking mechanic.

When airmen take damage their body will recoil.

The body parts of the dead body will match the orientation of the living body when the dead body is created.

Using /hide in match chat causes the chat window to appear only when composing a message.

Magnetic mines will not prime and attract until their damage ramp is complete. They can still be collided with and detonated during this period.

Grass will sway back and forth.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the short prop tool tip mass to match the actual stat.

Fixed boarding charges not being able to deal more than 1000 damage.

One of two players would become invisible to their attacker if they tried to kill each other at the same time.

Fixed crashing in the harbor siege.

AI airships better resist dunking themselves underwater.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.1: AI Improvements and a New Siege
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/7e34e2488b5a78bab527f224042f261696ed0e36.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The AI are getting smarter this update. They can now use most fixed weapons and will employ different strategies based on their loadout. Long range ships will flee if enemies get close and snipe from the edges of the battlefield. Broadsiders will strafe past their target to hit with fixed weaponry. Turret ships will dodge up and down to prevent fixed guns from staying on target.

1.6.1

Major Features

Upgraded AI with new strategies based on their loadout.

Added 5 new AI airships to the AI ship options in battle.

Added a new siege "Blockade" on Horizon. This siege will likely be more difficult for heavy ships.

Minor Features

Increased Revolver damage to 35 from 30.

Added some hand placed props to Horizon and Cauldron/High Tide.

Improvement to the destruction algorithm for better host performance.

Bug Fixes

Possible fix to servers not appearing until the client is restarted.

Railguns did not destroy part models belonging to the combine.

Mines sometimes lagged on explosion.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.6.0: Swap Ships in Lobby and Map Voting
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/13e3163e35090ae87acddebb13162859f95636f9.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen Update 1.6 brings the major convenience feature of swapping ships in lobby. Players can now more easily experience all siege maps with friends through the map voting system.

1.6.0

Major Features

You can now swap your ship in lobby. Verifcation must pass on both the client requesting the swap and the server.

You can now vote for a map. Selecting a map from the dropdown will cast your vote. The map changes if half+1 of the voting players agree.

Minor Features

If no servers appear a link to the steam server browser will appear as a backup. Servers can be joined 

Added a small trail effect that appears on the screen at high velocity. These lines follow your movement direction and can help judge velocity while piloting.

Added dividers to the parts list to help visually separate components.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.8.1: Team Colored Cosmetics
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/9086c9d7bca38761c662cfe89271e558d631ec6e.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Unfortunately, I didn't have much time to work recently so this week's update is small. 

Some balance concerns have been addressed. Mines are frequently being used in ramming attacks where gatling guns should be most effective. Their damage scaling time has been lengthened to weaken this strategy. Missile turn rates have also been reduced as after a hotfix they were turning much harder than intended.

1.5.8.1

Minor Features

Player glow will blink when low health.

Mines start their damage ramping 10 seconds later. Ramping previously started immediately and took 10 seconds.

Reduced turn speed of missiles. Missiles were previously buffed as a side effect of a hotfix.

The blue wizard hat and blue wolf pelt will appear red and orange respectively when worn by red team.

Bug Fixes

The crouch bind did not appear in the keybind options.
