notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.8: Magnetic Mines
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/c71ed93412437e3230f00dcd6f2b09b22d75b09d.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Airmen update 1.5.8 brings magnetic mines to the battlefield. Mines are intended as auxiliary weapons that excel at taking down unmaneuverable targets. Smaller ships will be able to speed through minefields if they pilot carefully. Bigger ships have no chance of escape if they venture to close. Mine damage is high but ultimately avoidable through good positioning, speed, or diligent defusing efforts.

1.5.8

Major Features

Added the magnetic mine layer. The mine layer can drop up to 5 mines at once and they are attracted to enemy ships. Mines explode in a large blast radius and stay active for 5 minutes. Double tapping the weapon group detonates all laid mines. Mines deal reduced damage for a short period after deploying. Mines have 600 hp.

Minor Features

Players can now stand on top of mines and missiles. For easy missile mounting, jump before take off.

Changed the respawn chamber collision geometry from a box to an octagon in battle.

If a captain disconnects, their ship weapons will be disabled.

Pigeon missiles and mines will not increase grief score if they deal team damage after a short period. You will still receive warnings.

Toggling a weapon group will reload any reloadable weapons in that group.

Added 2 new cosmetics unlockable using the magnetic mine layer.

Added 2 new example ships: a light missile ship (Slash) and a medium mine layer (Outpost).

Bug Fixes

Fixed ship positions desyncing when the captain disconnects.

Fixed jumping of crosshair rotation during turret reloading.

Missiles will no longer give hit markers when hitting nothing.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.7: Propeller Rebalance
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/59ba3b4cabf5a0afc0c0a503a9dd8248e598798a.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

Building a fast ship will be much easier in 1.5.7. Previously, propellers monopolized too much space on a fast airship so all their stats have been doubled. For a quick fix, remove every other prop on your airship to retain previous speeds. All example ships and AI have been appropriately updated or replaced.

1.5.7

Major Features

Added a team mass limit to prevent excessively low fps matches. This value is configurable through the server settings file and has been set to 45k in escort servers and 60k in seige.

Doubled the force, pressure draw, and HP of propellors so building a fast ship doesn't require ridiculous propellor spam.

Playing on Potato settings will use ultra low poly meshes for some parts.

Minor Features

Despookified the sandbox map.

Dulled and italicized chat notifications to better distinguish it from regular chat.

Added ammo indicators for firearm magazines.

Smoke screens now bind to and smoke the 4 engines they were placed nearest. Smoke screens bind in placement order.

Increased ram firepower cost, damage scaling, and max damage.

Enabling tooltips and connection faces will show a popup when pressing R would let you connect two pieces.

Clouds will not spawn near the starting points.

Added a master volume slider to the settings menu.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the occassional double listing of mass on lobby name plates.

Connection faces could not toggle on/off if a ship had hatches.

Fixed a discoloration in the revolver board.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.6: Melee Expansion
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/dae4319382434985fdf23210c804031207badec0.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

The melee expansion focuses on fleshing out the melee capabilities of all the weapons. The firearms now have a tertiary bash and other melee weapons now have a secondary attack if they didn't already. The player can now  also make unarmed strikes in the unfortunate event of having no tools on hand.

A few QoL changes have been added such as one-click sandbox and a pretty lobby background.

1.5.6

Major Features

Replaced the blue background of the lobby with a map view.

You can pitch down in addition to spinning background ships in the lobby.

Added an unarmed strike with 20 damage and -25 armor penetration to help wittle down spawn campers if no tools are immediately available.

Minor Features

Improved the smoke trail effect of carbine/revolver shots.

Added a secondary lunge to the boarding knife that does 55 damage but a long swing time and a thinner hitbox.

Reduced the range of the primary boarding knife attack.

Added an offhand left hook to the boarding axe.

Added an offhand melee to the revolver and carbine useable with F, labeled "Tertiary Attack" in keybindings. The revolver and carbine will use an alternate animation if equiped with a bayonet. Other players will see the default animation as the bayonet stabs aren't very visible in third person.

Improved the grappling hook's ability to counter momentum from a previous hook.

Increased hammer melee damage to 30 from 20.

Added a hitmarker for damaging allied airships and players.

Added a hitmarker for repairing parts and healing players.

Sandbox starts immediately when entering.

Typing /sandbox into chat enters sandbox ignoring ship requirements. This is nondefault to prevent new players from spending time testing and building a ship that violates requirements. 

Bug Fixes

Fixed a movement issue allowing players to walk on water.

The grappling hook would sometimes fire twice.

Fixed a bug that deletes challenge progress if the game closes improperly from the hangar.

Dying while falling would deal falling damage on respawn.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.3: Grappling Gun
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/15aaae4d9f4dc28e81a264f22c33aa961223892d.jpg

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update goes all in on a new tool: the Grappling Gun. The grappling gun provides a new angle of attack for potential boarders allowing them to expend a tool slot for a way aboard the enemy. 

The tool also aids counter boarders, equalizing some boarding actions where one ship has difficulty boarding the other while not completely nullifying a quality engagement.

1.5.3

Major Features

Added a grappling gun. The grappling gun is a short range boarding tool that pulls the user upon impact. Short range hits are accurate and long range hits are powerful. The grappling gun holds two charges and refills a charge every 30 seconds. Missing a shot refunds 15 seconds of the cooldown.

Minor Features

Added a revolver board.

Hitting the water at high speeds causes you to skip off the surface.

You sink slower in water and lose velocity when you submerge.

Remodeled fall damage to function based on fall speed on impact. This will allow a grappler to splat if grappling downwards so be wary.

Bug Fixes

Refixed gatling gun audio.

Fixed appearance location of build mode warnings.

Server browser match timers could not count above ~33 minutes.

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update goes all in on a new tool: the Grappling Gun. The grappling gun provides a new angle of attack for potential boarders allowing them to expend a tool slot for a way aboard the enemy. 

The tool also aids counter boarders, equalizing some boarding actions where one ship has difficulty boarding the other while not completely nullifying a quality engagement.

1.5.3

Major Features

Added a grappling gun. The grappling gun is a short range boarding tool that pulls the user upon impact. Short range hits are accurate and long range hits are powerful. The grappling gun holds two charges and refills a charge every 30 seconds. Missing a shot refunds 15 seconds of the cooldown.

Minor Features

Added a revolver board.

Hitting the water at high speeds causes you to skip off the surface.

You sink slower in water and lose velocity when you submerge.

Remodeled fall damage to function based on fall speed on impact. This will allow a grappler to splat if grappling downwards so be wary.

Bug Fixes

Refixed gatling gun audio.

Fixed appearance location of build mode warnings.

Server browser match timers could not count above ~33 minutes.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.2: Connection Face Indicators
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/7ac1ebfa946a6aae64843891732bfa78ccf8424c.png

Join us on Discord for public playtests Friday at 3pm ET, Saturday at 3pm ET, and Monday at 7pm ET.

This update attempts to address one of the common difficulties of building: figuring out why two parts don't connect. The crosshatching pairs with a colored dot on the crosshair to help players understand where they can and cannot place their selected part. 

1.5.2

Major Features

Added color coded crosshatching to connection surfaces so new players can more readily identify what parts connect. This is enabled by default but can be disabled in the settings menu.

Minor Features

Rebalanced longneck damage to start at 50 and ramp to 150 between 50m and 150m. Previously did 100/200 between 100m/200m.

Spawn HP decays in a fixed amount of time, regardless of damage taken.

Added 50 more HP to spawn protection (same decay rate) so one person cannot spawn camp two people in one chamber.

Reduced requirements on most challenges so its quicker to unlock cosmetics.

Increased gatling gun damage from 30 to 35.

Added a warning before grief kicking players.

Once a ship changes hands it becomes fair game to damage for both teams for the rest of the match regardless of team.

Reduced fps lag caused by placing/deleting parts on bigger ships.

Bug Fixes

Removed lag dependence on autopilot controls.

Fixed scaling of world space HUD elements when zooming.

Fixed railgun particle behaving awkwardly when moving between shots.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.1: Boarding Charge Rework
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/763a1d07cef50a012f07ec45231a0bd16ebd95c4.jpg

Join us on Discord for the next public playtest at 7pm ET!

Previously boarding charges could never deal large amount of damage because there isn't much to do about suicide bombing airmen with 3 boarding charges. Making them disarmable allows for a damage buff to make them more effective. With percent HP damage, boarding charges are not useless when placed on larger components, but a long fuse requires the boarder to defend any placed charges.

1.5.1

Major Features

Reworked boarding charges to have %HP damage to help take down bigger parts. A longer fuse, indicator, and disarmability add counterplay for the boarded crew and allow these buffs.

Minor Features

Added splashes when projectiles go underwater.

Added two new airmen heads the Brain in a Jar and the Nautilus.

Added a new carbine cosmetic that departs further from the existing style.

Added three new challenges: parts destroyed with the boarding charge, carbine kills on underwater enemies, and knife kills underwater.

Altered the splash particle for the player character entering water.

You can now interrupt swapping weapons to swap weapons.

bug Fixes

Fixed hit oil on the cutlass.

Restored grass and trees to build mode.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.5.0: Water Overhaul and Performance Buff
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/67764fcdbc793321614b5513253b666512ffe0f1.png

Dive in with us on Discord for the next public playtests Friday and Saturday at 3pm ET.

Water in previous version of airmen served to do nothing other than tint your screen. Now, it gives a second life to downed airships. Balloons float and provide extra lift when submerged, engines turn off, and guns cool faster but cannot fire. Companion content for the new water features will roll out across the next week.

A new ship rendering technique brings massive performance gains of about a flat 40% off the time it takes to render any airship. This means a lot for big ship battles as larger ships take longer to render. This method exploits typical rendering procedures to function so some crazy visual bugs may occur if anything goes wrong with part shading or destruction.

1.5.0

Major Features

Huge performance buff for rendering airships (40% off normal time to render for all ships).

Balloons resist submersion in water so a downed ship will float in deep water.

Minor Features

Raised the sea level in sandbox so water interactions are easily testable.

Firearms and ship weapons do not fire when submerged.

Cannons cool off three times as fast when submerged.

Added a new escort map "High Tide", Cauldron with a higher water level.

Reworked the underwater effect.

Twin cannons gain inaccuracy much slower.

Bug Fixes

Remote client's cannons did not recoil for the host of a non dedicated server.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.4.6: Turning Overhaul
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/8ebf53daedd5054a6094914689070cddde5ca607.png

Join us for the next public playtest today (Monday) at 7pm ET.

This update focus on airship turning. Changes eliminate physics based effects to bring rudders away from reality and closer to expectation. Other turning changes like the addition of prop turning work to make building a ship that turns well much easier.

1.4.6

Major Features

Upright rudders now apply forces as if a "ghost rudder" was in the exact opposite position. Placing rudders solely in the front or back of your ship will function the same as placing them in the front and back.

A ship with no rudders will use it's propellers to turn. Reversing functions as it would with tank controls (A/D controls pivot direction) rather than car controls (A/D controls turning circle position). A ship built with rudders that loses them will switch to this scheme.

Minor Features

Added an angular speedometer needle so pilots can more precisely control angular velocity.

Reduced forces of rudders without reducing their top speeds. This lengthens the time it takes to reach top turning speed which was previously near instant. They will also diminish speed slower now making ships drift more (stabilizers reduce drift).

Increased beam HP by 300-200 so they are not a poor choice over the 3x1 armor root as a mounting point.

Added more built-in angular drag around only the airship's forward and right axis.

Small torques created by asymmetrical propeller placement will not turn the ship when moving forward or backwards.

Stabilizers will not apply force if it would work against user input. Use to make an airship slow its turn speed faster.

Added a "Join the Discord" button to the server browser scene to help bring players to the Discord community. This button opens a webpage to the server.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.4.5: Dynamic Level of Detail and Turning Tweaks
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/0a8a5f4e555d5a2f107773689ea0eb245e7f2075.png

Join us on Discord for public playtesting Friday at 3pm ET and Saturday at 3pm ET.

Airmen 1.4.5 adds dynamic level of detail to most parts in the game. LOD helps take a load off graphics processing by swapping out the models of parts to something simple and quick to render when far away. The perfect balance of LOD means you'll never notice the impostor models at a distance and grab some bonus frames per second. 

The fade away start distance can be configured to personal preference in the hangar setting menu. Those in dire need of FPS can minimize this value and see the low detail models at close range.

1.4.5

Major Features

Added dynamic level of detail to many parts. The fade point can be adjusted using the new Level of Detail Bias slider in the settings menu.

Angular drag is proportional to translational drag so balloon placement location does not influence turning speed. Ships with spread out balloons should spin faster and ships with collected balloons will spin slower.

Minor Feature

The escort point marker will stay constrained to the screen to prevent confusing with the delivery points.

The escort point marker is a diamond rather than square to further differentiate it.

Melee attacks cannot damage allies so numbers advantage in melee is more reliable.

Increased the max steepness the player can walk up.

A small slow is applied when moving downhill.

Bug Fixes

The player's hand was visible when zoomed with the spyglass.

Ships with mass exactly equal to lift could not ascend.

Sideways rudders did not turn out of the way when point turning. 

Fixed the black outline of the crosshair in build mode.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.4.4: New Rudder Shapes and Capture Point Changes
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/042d389dd1048b9f055f2d605e9bb850831ecd2f.png

Join us on the Discord for a playtest tonight at 7pm ET and tomorrow at 3pm ET.

1.4.4

Major Features

The capture point pushes slower, rather than stopping completely, when both teams contest. Speed is based on mass on point where controlling 50% of mass on point pushes at zero speed.

Minor Features

Added 3 new rudder shapes. A tall rudder, front mounted rudder, and fixed rudder.

Implemented a minimum angular drag to reduce wobbliness of ultra light ships.

Reduced braking forces caused by using rudders.

The capture point is now a smushed sphere and extends down only 75 meters rather than infinitely.

The capture point pushes slow in the beginning of the game and faster at the end.

Added a HUD indicator for the escort capture point to relay capture point position, owner, and push speed.

Added unique hitmarkers for player kills and player hits.

Extended gatling gun range and damage falloff start distance by 25% and reduced spread by 25%.

Changed railgun particle to better indicate where the last shot went.

Added zoom to the longneck cannon toggleable using right mouse button.

All zoom is now variable and adjustable with the mousewheel.

Zooming blacks out all but the center of the screen.

Bug Fixes

Improved symetry of rod and cone balloon hangar colliders.

Fixed 3rd person shoulder rotation issues visible while wielding carbine/revolver while wearing upper arm armor.

Kills were not recorded in the scoreboard for a nondedicated host.

The twin cannon challenge "Rudders Destroyed" was mislabelled. 

The dragon tail was not classed as a rudder for the purposes of advancing challenges.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.4.3: Firearm Reloads and Light Balloons
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/7b4471f7b026c4df78ecd858a9699c18fe721bd6.jpg

Test out the update with us today or tomorrow at 3pm ET!

New balloons and firearm updates hit the battlefield. Bottomless magazines are no more and the revolver and carbine now have 6 and 8 shots per magazine respectively. Each can be reloaded early with the R key and the chambering and reloading animations can now be canceled by switching weapons.

The revolver receives a larger scale update where cocking the hammer is now option. Cocking the hammer provides pinpoint accuracy and instant response. Firing uncocked introduces base inaccuracy and a short delay as the mechanism cycles.

1.4.3

Major Features

The revolver has a 6 shot magazine and can be reloaded with R. 

Cocking the hammer of the revolver is done manually with left mouse button. Firing without cocking is less accurate and has a short delay.

The carbine has an 8 shot magazine and can be reloaded with R.

Minor Features

Restored debris. This required a Unity update so there are likely to be lots of weird bugs cropping up.

Newly unlocked cosmetics will be labeled as so until equipped.

Added rod and cap balloons. Two balloons between the size of the armored balloon and drum/cap. 

The carbine will bump up and down on screen as you run.

Carbine and revolver reloads can be canceled by switching weapons.

Dismantling the ship in hangar resets the save name field to prevent overwriting another ship.

Renamed Sandbox/Deathmatch buttons and highlighted the Deathmatch button in red.

Added a quick siege button to instantly enter a siege lobby from the hangar.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.3.0: Siege Mode Expansion
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29199374/082d784473317ab2de1d1633509b4f2bb6cee24f.png

AI turrets would not fire when upside down and aiming on the edge of their FOV.
AI turrets targeted too high or too low above their target.
AI longneck and twin cannons aimed to compensate for projectile drop they did not have.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.1.3: AI Turrets on Player Ships and Gyro Stabilizers
notes.content:
Join us for a playtest today at 3pm ET or Saturday tomorrow at 3pm and test out this update's new features.

Sometimes its hard to find a crew for turret heavy ships and fixed-gun battles can feel predetermined. To combat this a new placeable turret controller is available. The turret controller binds to the nearest turret and mans it at the cost of firepower and pressure. 

A gyro stabilizer has been added to help keep non-silicon based life firing at high accuracy in turbulent situations. 

Player movement has received a slight overhaul. There should be less random plummeting, unexpected disembarking, and getting stuck in cracks.

1.1.3
Major Features	Added a gyrostabilizer component that binds to the nearest turret. The nearest turret is determined through connected parts.	Added an AI turret controller that binds to the nearest turret. AI turrets prioritize the engines of the nearest non disabled enemy. The nearest turret is determined through connected parts.Minor Features	Tweaked player movement to prevent extreme shunting near edges.	Slope slows only apply when moving up a slope and ramp up faster so fewer steep slopes can be climbed.	Reduced xz power of angled jumping.	Improved sliding for less sudden ejection.	Jumping has a 0.25s cooldown. This works against hill climbing and makes melee combat less spastic.	Jump can be held down for continuous jumping.	Hitting a player with a boarding knife or axe wets the blade with "Robot Juice" (patent pending). Swinging or sheathing the weapon cleans it.	Added an option to hide player names in game to the settings menu.	Added an option to prevent loading example ships to the settings menu.	Added an option to hide global chat to the settings menu.	Added an extra sonic boom puff to rail gun shots and changed the "projectile" to a glowing bolt.	Fill in the favorite ship box with the name of your favorite ship and it will load when you start the game.	Holding shift and selecting a tool removes that tool from your inventory.	Shrunk the width of the parts menu scroll bar to allow more space for part names.	Increased large engine hp to 3250.	Increased ballast balloon ballast force by 2 and pressure draw by 1.5.	Tweaked the AHull example ship for better traversability. Renamed to AHullMkVI.	AI turrets target part center of mass instead of part origin.Bug Fixes	Mounting a turret always faces you the same direction as the turret.	Rail gun particle effects match their 600 unit range.	Fixed the immediate camera drift when switching to spectate camera.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.1.2: Custom Keybinds and Vertical Props
notes.content:
Join us for our next public playtest 8/4 at 5pm ET and test out the newest features.

Non-qwerty keyboard users rejoice: you can now change keybindings from the launcher. Global chat is persistent even during games and you can use TAB (by default) to cycle between match and global chat. Escort's objective seemed a bit hard to make sense of so the escort point has been distinguished with a gold border. Pigeon missiles have been pushed further into there intended niche of heavy ship destroyers.

AI ships will automatically be added when a player captains.AI based matches will start when a single captain is ready, rather than 2.A chat message appears when attempting to ready too early in a match lobby.The escort point HUD marker has a gold border and is black when uncontested.Pigeon missiles will seek the heaviest target further than 100 meters and less than 400, rather than the furthest target.Pigeons missiles have 100 less pressure draw to make them easier to use on light ships.Pigeon missiles can travel for 2 additional seconds before exploding. notes.title: Airmen Update 1.1.1: Global Chat and AI Fixes
notes.content:
1.1.1

Join us in the skies tonight at 7 PM ET and try Airmen's newest features.

This update fixes critical AI bugs and roots out more bugs in the path of getting into a match. A global chat has also been added to help get players out of the builder and into a lobby if other's are looking for crew. Firearm animations have also been tweaked for smoothness.

Major Features

Added global chat. You will leave the global chat when in lobby or a deathmatch.

Minor Features

Tweaked the animation of firing the carbine and revolver to be more lively in 1st person.

Servers appear on the list as they are recieved and a message informs you of when the list is starting and finishing an update.

All AI turrets begin firing at their max range.

AI cannon turrets scale their firerate based on target distance.

Added 7 more example ships and tweaked the existing ones to pass verification.

Added a new helmet for reconnaissance airmen.

Bug Fixes

Player models no longer tilt their left arm when aiming the revolver.

1st person player models hide the left hand when aiming.

Greatly reduced probability of failing to get server metadata like player count and version number.

Servers no longer compute collisions when there are no AI present. This prevents server crashes from occuring due to intense collisions.

Fixed AI immediately falling to the ground.

Fixed AI always building a stack when they circle eachother.

Possible fix to servers causing clients to crash on joining after a match.

Boarding charges did not add damage to the scoreboard.

notes.title: Airmen Update 1.1.0: New Map and More Light Turrets
notes.content:
Airmen's first weekly update drops a new map and brings light turret options into parity with heavy. The player counts always reading zero has now been fixed, which should help everyone get together in one lobby.

If you are interested in playing with us at Airborne Games, we are hosting a public playtest Friday at 5pm ET. All you need is the latest version of the game. Playtests usually last for 1 hour. If you can't make it this Friday, we host them every Saturday at 3pm ET and Monday at 7pm ET.

Major Features
Added a new escort map: Spearhead. Spearhead is mountainous with flank routes for light ships.
Minor Features
The game mode can be altered from the lobby by a moderator.Added light turret versions of the the gatling and cannon.Made clouds less flat. Some will have rounded tops.Altered grass shader to be hard edged like leaves and avoid weird z-fighting issues.If the lobby times out, you will return to server browser rather than hangar.Added a 3x1 armor fork.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the visuals of the longneck smoke discharge.Fixed servers always setting the map to default after a refresh.Fixed the direct connect button which was nonfunctional.Fixed player count usually reading zero.
Check out the new map before you get in game:

http://i.imgur.com/SqRnQZ1.jpg

notes.title: Airmen Update 0.65.1: Siege Mode & Escort Mode
notes.content:
0.65.1

Major Features
Siege mode: Siege is a co-op gamemode with a preset AI team with unique spawn locations. Siege mode AI are typically immobile fortresses. Win by disabling all enemies.Escort Mode: Escort mode is a versus mode where teams must escort a single capture point to the other side of the map. Completing the escort or disabling all enemies for 30 seconds win the match. Disabled ships cannot contest. The point only moves when occupied by one team.You will be unable to respawn on a ship not controlled by your team if that ship is not your original ship. If your new homeship is on the enemy team you will instead spawn on your original ship. If you cannot spawn on that ship, you will be permenently killed.
Minor Features
If time runs out, the team with the most capture points wins.Smoking barrel effects on carbine and revolver.Smoother bullet trail on carbine, gatling, and revolver.Replaced tree with a better looking and higher performance model/style.Opened up the hangar for better visual contrast.Grass fades in smoothly.Tweaked revolver model to look better proportioned.
Bug Fixes
Less random crashes but possible performance drops.The reconstruct button will no longer grow after every use.Cleaned up the carbine model.Players can no longer climb cliffs with frequent spacebar application.Repair was inconsistent based on camera angle.Chat will no longer be locked after clicking a button. Fixed a bug where the victory timer did not reset if the victor changed during the countdown.Team blips do not immediately appear on all ships.
Download
https://bronze-johnson.itch.io/airmen

notes.title: Airmen Update 0.65.0: New Map and Pigeon Missile Overhaul
notes.content:
0.65.0

Major Features

Weapons below 30% HP are disabled until repaired above this threshold. Disabled weapons behave the same as weapons without sufficient pressure.

Doubled repair power. Scrap cost remains the same.

Added a new map: Ridgline. Ridgeline has 3 capture points spaced further away from eachother. The map can be swapped by the server host or by using the /map "id" command. Map ids count up from 0.

Added multiplayer sandbox gamemode. The game mode can be swapped by the server host. Infinite match time. No friendly fire. Instant respawns.

Pigeon missiles will ignore targets obscured by clouds when they search for targets shortly after launch. Smokescreen will also obscure view. Targets obsucred after launch will be lost while obsucred but cam be retargetted.

Pigeon missiles target engines.

Minor Features

Slightly reduced the dead zone size of pigeon missiles.

Smoke screens release smoke at four engines each.

Doubled duration of smoke screen.

Repair hammers can heal allies.

Harpoons pull with less power based on ship pressure.

Reduced harpoon HP to be destructable with one knife/revolver hit.

The lobby timer jumps to 30 seconds if any captain moves with less than 30 seconds remaining.

Ballast cannot lift a ship with insufficent lift (can still slow descent and maintain altitude).

Increased twin cannon armor pen 5 > 10.

Removed damage ramping of twin cannon (100% at all ranges).

Reduced armor balloon HP by 500 and increase drag coefficent by 0.2. All highly successful ship have used this balloon.

Ram momentum damage scaling reduced. Still dealing max at low velocities.

Grass is not rendered on the two lowest graphics settings.

Terrain quality adjusts more with graphics setting.

Added contents to scrap boxes that diminish as scrap is removed.

Added 20 scrap to boxes.

Finishing the activation channel on a scrap box deposits your scrap into the box. Releasing the channel early withdraws as normal.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the fuzziness of UI elements such as nametags, ship blips, and capture point blips.

Fixed a bug that allowed parts with 3+ connection points to be placed out of bounds (forcing a restart without saving).

The boarding knife goes completely off screen.

Players will not drop multiple dead bodies when dying in sandbox.

notes.title: Airmen Update 0.64.3: Boarding Knife and Turning Changes
notes.content:
0.64.3

Major Features
